sa: नित्यं ते बन्धुलुब्धस्य तिष्ठतो भ्रातृसौहृदे। मार्गमार्यं प्रपन्नस्य नानुमन्येत कः पुमान्॥
en: Who will not endorse what has fallen from you, ever engaged in serving your friends, established in fraternal love, and who have entered upon a noble course?

sa: तां लतामिव वेष्टन्तीमालिङ्गन्तीं महाद्रुमान्। मुञ्च मुञ्चेति बहुशः प्राप तां राक्षसाधिपः॥
en: Exclaiming repeatedly, Leave off! Leave off, the lord of the Rākşasas got at her, as she was clasping a mighty trees as if it were a creeper.

sa: अमन्त्रयत कृत्स्नश्च तस्याः सर्वः सखीजनः। यथायं समुपक्रान्तो निःशेष नः करिष्यति॥
en: Then her companions in a body took counsel of each other, saying, “considering the way in which he has entered upon it, he will annihilate us quite."

sa: आत्मना चात्मजैश्चान्यैर्वृणे यं मनुजर्षभम्। तेन रामेण कैकेयि शपे ते वचनक्रियाम्॥
en: By that Rama, O Kaikeyi, foremost of men, whom I hold dearer than my other sons, do I swear that, I will accomplish whatever you will say.

sa: सावित्री पतिशुश्रूषां कृत्वा स्वर्गे महीयते। तथावृत्तिश्च याता त्वं पतिशुश्रूषया दिवम्॥
en: Having served her lord. Sāvitri is highly honoured in heaven; and you also, following the same course, by virtue of having served your husband, has secured heaven.

sa: तस्य लाङ्गलहस्तस्य कृषतः क्षेत्रमण्डलम्। अहं किलोत्थिता भित्त्वा जगतीं नृपतेः सुता॥
en: As he was ploughing a plain intended for a sacrifice, I rose from under the earth; and (in this sense) I am the daughter of that king.

sa: किं नु मेऽयं दिवास्वप्नश्चित्तमोहोऽपि वा मम। अनुभूतोपसर्गो वा मनसो वाप्युपद्रवः॥
en: Is this a day-dream to me or has bewilderment befallen my senses? Is this owing to influence of some evil spirit or has my mind been affected?

sa: किल्बिषं त्वं नरेन्द्राणां करिष्यसि नराधिप। यो दत्त्वा वरमद्यैव पुनरन्यानि भाषसे।॥
en: Surely, O lord of men, you will bring disgrace to all the monarchs (of your line), since having conferred the boons this very day, you speak otherwise.

sa: राघवे हि वनं प्राप्ते सर्वलोकस्य धिक्कृतम्। मृत्युरक्षमणीयं मां नयिष्यति यमक्षयम्॥
en: And Rāghava having gone to the forest, Death will surely summon me away to his abode who am of exceedingly reprehensible character, and who am universally execrated.

sa: हन्तेदानीं सकामा तु कैकेयी बान्धवैः सह। हियेयं धर्मकामस्य धर्मपत्नी यशस्विनः॥
en: Ah! being the virtuous wife of the virtuous and far-famed Rāma, I have been stolen away. Now has the desire of Kaikeyi and other relations been fulfilled.

sa: नाकुण्डली नामुकुटी नास्रग्वी नाल्पभोगवान्। नामृष्टो न नलिप्ताङ्गो नासुगन्धश्च विद्यते ॥
en: And all wore ear-rings and tiaras and garlands, and abundantly enjoyed the good things of life. And all were clean, daubing their limbs, and perfuming their persons.

sa: अथवा मृगशावाक्षी मृग जानासि मैथिलीम्। मृगविप्रेक्षणी कान्ता मृगीभिः सहिता भवेत्॥
en: Again addressed he the diverse animals-O dear, know you for certain about Janakī having the eyes of a doe; is she engaged in play with the does?

sa: इन्द्रो ह्यश्रुनिपातं तं स्वगात्रे पुण्यगन्धिनम्। सुरभिं मन्यते दृष्ट्वा भूयसी तामिहेश्वरः॥
en: And that lord, Indra, also considered Surabhi of a person breathing a sacred odour, whose tears had dropped on his body, as the foremost being on earth.

sa: स वीर्योत्सेकदुष्टात्मा वरदानेन मोहितः। जगाम स महाकायः समुद्रं सरितां पतिम्॥
en: That wicked one of a gigantic body inflated by his prowess and blinded by the boon he had received once went to that lord of streams—the Sea.

sa: इत्येवमुक्त्वा भरतो महात्मा प्रियेतरैर्वाक्यगणैस्तुदंस्ताम्। शोकार्दितश्चापि ननाद भूयः सिंहो यथा मन्दरकन्दरस्थः॥
en: The high-souled Bharata afflicted (his mother) with multitudes of words causing pain; and distressed with grief, emitted sounds like to a lion in the cave of Mandāra.

sa: इति तेषु ब्रुवाणेषु सर्वास्तांश्च महीपतीन्॥ अब्रवीत् तानिदं वाक्यं सुमन्त्रो राजसत्कृतः।
en: While they were thus conversing, the charioteer Sumantra, well respected by the king, reached there and spoke to all those persons and the kings the following words.

sa: सुमहान्त्यपि भूतानि देवाश्च पुरुषर्षभ । न दैवस्य प्रमुञ्चन्ति सर्वभूतानि देहिनः॥
en: O you best of men, what of insignificant beings cased in this frail body, even the mighty creatures and celestials are subject to the influence of destiny.

sa: आचम्य च यथाशास्त्रं नदी तां सह सीतया। प्रणमत्प्रीतिसंतुष्टो लक्ष्मणश्च महारथः।७९।।
en: Then that mighty car-warrior, Laksmana, sipping water from the river as laid down in the scriptures, bowed down to it along with Sītā in gladness of heart.

sa: स तेषां राजपुत्राणां कर्तुकामो जलक्रियाम्। स जलार्थी महातेजा न चापश्यज्जलाशयम्॥
en: And desirous of offering oblations of water to those princes, that highly powerful one, in need of water, did not find any watery expanse in the neighbourhood.

sa: त्वं हि त्रिपथगे देवि ब्रह्मलोकं समक्षसे। भार्या चोदधिराजस्य लोकेऽस्मिन् सम्प्रदृश्यसे॥
en: O you that wend in three ways, O revered one, you envelope the regions of Brahma. You appear in this world as the spouse of the Ocean-king.

sa: भ्राता वैश्रवणस्याहं सापत्नो वरवर्णिनि। रावणो नाम भद्रं ते दशग्रीवः प्रतापवान्॥
en: O you of a beatiful countenance, I am the step-brother of the Lord of wealth and my name is the mighty Ten-necked Rāvana May good betide you!

sa: मावमंस्था दशरथं भर्तारं वरदं पतिम्। भर्तुरिच्छा हि नारीणां पुत्रकोट्या विशिष्यते॥
en: You ought not to bring down your boonbestowing lord and husband Daśaratha; for surely the wish of a husband to a wife outweighs a koti of sons.

sa: तवेष्टा ननु चैवेमा भार्याश्चन्द्रनिभाननाः। इदानीं नेक्षसे कस्मात सुग्रीवं प्लवगेश्वर ॥
en: Those your wives, having moon-like countenances, have always your welfare in view. Why did you not, O best of monkeys, cast your looks towards them and Sugrīva?

sa: प्रादुर्भूतं ततः क्षीरं कृत्तिकानामनुत्तमम्। षण्णां षडाननो भूत्वा जग्राह स्तनजं पयः॥
en: And then the teats of the Křttikās were filled with milk; and thereupon assuming six mouths, he began to suck milk from the teats of those six.

sa: देवकार्यमिदं देव समाधत्स्व हुताशन । शैलपुत्र्यां महातेजो गङ्गायां तेज उत्सृज॥
en: ‘Do you, O god, accomplish this work of the oddities! O you of mighty energy, do you discharge your energy into that daughter of the Mountain, Ganga.

sa: पितुः सत्यं प्रतिश्रुत्य हत्वा भरतमाहवे। किं करिष्यामि राज्येन सापवादेन लक्ष्मण॥
en: Having promised to maintain my father's truth, what, O Laksmana, shall I, having slain Bharata in battle, do with the kingdom with a stain attached to it?

sa: नैर्ऋतो रावणो नाम तस्य भार्या हरिष्यति। राक्षसेन्द्रो जनस्थाने अवध्यः सुरदानवैः॥
en: A friend named Rāvana, the lord of Rākşasas, incapable of being slain by either the gods or the Dāvanas, shall carry off his Rāma's) spouse in Janasthāna.

sa: उत्सहेयमहं कर्तुमद्यैव त्वां सपक्षकम्। इहस्थस्त्वं हि लोकानां हितं कार्यं करिष्यसि॥
en: I could this very day furnish you with wings. But, by staying here in this condition, you wilt be able to compass the welfare of the worlds.

sa: सोऽभिदुद्राव वेगेन रामं दृष्ट्वा विशाम्पतिः। तमसम्प्राप्य दुःखार्तः पपात भुवि मूर्च्छितः॥
en: And casting his eyes on Rāma, the king rushed towards him, but before reaching his son, the aggrieved monarch fell down to the earth in a Swoon.

sa: शोकः संधार्यतां मातर्हृदये साधु मा शुचः। वनवासादिहैष्यामि पुनः कृत्वा पितुर्वचः॥
en: Do you, Oh mother, assuage your grief within your heart; lament not you, I shall return home again from the wood after making good my father's words.

sa: स इदानीमहं वृद्धः प्लवने मन्दविक्रमः। यौवने च तदासीन्मे बलमप्रतिमं परम्॥
en: But I who was all this, have waxed old, and my vigour sits feebly upon me. In my youth, ever, my strength was exceeding great and incomparable.

sa: किं तवापकृतं राजन् वने निवसता मया॥ जिहीर्घरम्भो गुर्वर्थं यदहं ताडितस्त्वया।
en: What wrong, O monarch, had I residing in the woods done you, that coming to procure water for my parents, I have been thus afflicted by. you?

sa: नहि पश्याम्यहं लोके यः कुर्यान्मम विप्रियम्। अमरेषु सहस्राक्षं महेन्द्रं पाकशासनम्।७।।
en: In this world I do not see him that would do me : wrong, not even the mighty Indra, the thousand eyed tamer of the demon Pāka.

sa: रात्र्यां तु तस्यां व्युष्टायां भरद्वाजोऽब्रवीदिदम्। मधुमूलफलोपेतं चित्रकूटं व्रजेति ह॥ वासमौपयिकं मन्ये तव राम महाबल। नानानगगणोपेतः किन्नरोरगसेवितः॥ मयूरनादाभिरतो गजराजनिषेवितः। गम्यतां भवता शैलश्चित्रकूटः स विश्रुतः॥
en: On Rāma having passed the night there, Bharadvāja spoke to him, “Do you race your steps to Citrakuța filled with delicious fruits and roots. I deem that, О mighty Rāma, as a fit abode for you, being, as it is, furnished with various kinds of trees, inhabited by crowds of Kinnars, resounding with the cries of peacocks, and frequented by gigantic elephants.

sa: सधूमाश्च शराः सर्वे मम युद्धाभिनन्दिताः। रुक्मपृष्ठानि चापानि विचेष्टन्ते विचक्षण ॥
en: And, O discerning one, rejoicing at the prospect of my fight, all these arrows emit smoke, and my bows plaited on the back with gold, are restless.

sa: तं हि चिन्तयमानायाः शोकोऽयं हृदि वर्धते। नदीनामिव वेगेन समुद्रसलिलं महत्॥
en: And fostered by thought on my part, this grief increases in my bosom, like the mighty waters of the ocean increased by the vehement discharge of rivers.

sa: अग्निकार्येषु च सदा सुमनोभिश्च देवताः॥ पूज्यास्ते मत्कृते देवि ब्राह्मणाश्चैव सत्कृताः।
en: Do you beguile your time, Oh worshipful one, expecting my return, by worshipping the celestials with flowers and oblations to the fire and serving well the Brahmins.

sa: आत्मवान् को जितक्रोधो द्युतिमान् कोऽनसूयकः। कस्य बिभ्यति देवाश्च जातरोषस्य संयुगे॥
en: Who has subdued his heart, and controlled his anger, is endowed with splendour, and devoid of malice; and whom enraged in battle, do even the gods, fear?

sa: ततश्च हरिशार्दूलस्तानुवाच वनौकसः॥ कोऽपि लोके न मे वेगं प्लवने धारयिष्यति।
en: Then that tiger-like monkey said to those rangers of the woods, None in this world would be able to sustain my impetus in the act of bounding.

sa: गुरुकार्याणि सर्वाणि नियुज्य कुशिकात्मजे॥ ऊषुस्तां रजनीं तत्र सरय्वां ससुखं त्रयः।
en: Then Rāma having rendered to Kuśika's son all the duties pertaining to a spiritual guide, the three happily spent that night on the banks of the Sarayu.

sa: प्राणत्यागविशङ्केन कृतं तेन महत् प्रियम्। तस्य मार्गाम वैदेहीं पृथिव्यामपि चाम्बरे॥
en: He has performed a great service at the risk of his life-we shall therefore find out Vaidehī whether she is in this earth or in the welkin,

sa: तेनास्य मुनिमुख्यस्य धर्मज्ञस्य महात्मनः। न किञ्चिदस्त्यविदितं भूतं भव्यं च राघव॥
en: O descendant of Raghu, there is nothing present, past, or future which is not known by that foremost of ascetics of high soul, and cognizant of morality.

sa: अहं ते नानुवक्तव्यो विशेषेण कदाचन। अनुकूलतया शक्यं समीपे तस्य वर्तितुम्॥
en: You should not extol me even in the company of your friends; you shall be then able to live with Bharata as one favourable to his party.

sa: तस्मै दत्तं नृपतिना यौवराज्यं सनातनम्। स प्रसाद्यस्त्वया सीते नृपतिश्च विशेषतः॥
en: The monarch has granted him this lasting heir appearentship; it is therefore proper for you, Oh Sītā, to please him specially for he is the king now.

sa: ततो देवाः सगन्धर्वाः सिद्धाश्च परमर्षयः। भागप्रतिग्रहार्थं वै समवेता यथाविधि ॥
en: And the deities, with the Gandharvas, and the Siddhas, and the principal saints, assembled there duly with the object of each obtaining his share of the offerings.

sa: सा समासाद्य तौ वीरौ व्रजन्तं भ्रातुरग्रतः। एहि रस्यावहेत्युक्त्वा समालम्भत लक्ष्मणम्॥
en: Beholding there the two brothers, Rāma and Laksmana, she neared the heroes and saying, 'come, we shall sport' assailed Laksmana who had been going before his brother.

sa: स तथाप्युग्रतेजाः स निर्धूतस्तस्य तेजसा। पत्रे गुह्यान्तरे सक्तो मतिमान् संवृतोऽभवत्॥
en: And effulgent as he was, that highly intelligent monkey hid himself on a branch covered with leaves, being unable to stand before the effulgence of that Rākșasa.

sa: साप्येवं ब्रुवतीं सीतां सरमा मृदुभाषिणी। उवाच वचनं तस्याः स्पृशन्ती बाष्पविक्लवम्।।१२
en: This is the highest favour that I seek (at hands). Thereat, the mild-speeched Saramā, wiping (Sītā's) face washed in tears, spoke to her, as she said this.

sa: स ददर्श ततो रामः शक्त्या भिन्नं महाहवे। लक्ष्मणं रुधिरादिग्धं सपन्नगमिवाचलम्॥
en: Rāma saw Lakşmaņa with his chest riven by the dart in the mighty conflict lying drenched in blood, and resembling a hill with serpents present in it.

sa: भगवंस्तनयां मे त्वं गुणैः स्वैरेव भूषिताम्। भिक्षां प्रतिगृहाणेमां महर्षे स्वयमुद्यताम्॥
en: O worshipful one, O mighty sage, do you accept this daughter of mine, adorned with her native perfections, who of herself has come to you as alms.

sa: तं विजित्य मुहूर्तेन जघ्ने दैत्यांश्चतुःशतम्॥ ततः पाण्डुरमेघाभं कैलासमिव भास्वरम्। वरुणस्यालयं दिव्यमपश्यद्राक्षसाधिपः॥ क्षरन्तीं च पयस्तत्र सुरभिं गामवस्थिताम्। यस्याः पयोभिनिष्पन्दात्क्षीरोदो नाम सागरः॥
en: Having vanquished him, he, in a moment, destroyed four hundred Daityas. And then the lord of Rākṣasas saw the grand abode of Varuņa resembling a mass of white clouds, and effulgent like to Kailāśa itself;—and also saw the milkconserving Surabhi stationed there; from the streams of whose milk was produced the ocean named Ksiroda.

sa: क्व गच्छसि वरारोहे कां सिद्धिं भजसे स्वयम्। कस्याभ्युदयकालोऽयं यस्त्वां समुपभोक्ष्यते।।२१
en: Where are you going, O beautiful damsel? Whom are you going of your own accord to satisfy? Whose prosperous time has appeared, with whom you shall enjoy?

sa: तेषां दुमाणां प्रभया मेरोरिव महाकपिः। अमन्यत तदा वीरः काञ्चनोऽस्मीति सर्वतः॥
en: By the lustre of all those trees that heroic monkey appeared as if made of gold like to the Sun by the touch of the mount Sumeru.

sa: आहूय सोऽङ्गदं कोपात्ताडयामास वेगितः। गदया कम्पनः पूर्व स चचाल भृशाहतः॥
en: Thereat, challenging Angada in wrath, he assailed him with impetuosity. And Kampana dealt a blow to Angada with his mace; and thereat, wounded with it, he reeled.

sa: अयं हि जलसम्भूतो मणिः प्रवरपूजितः। यज्ञे परमतुष्टेन दत्तः शक्रेण धीमता॥
en: And this jewel, obtained from the bed of the ocean, was conferred on him (Janaka) by the intelligent Sakra, greatly delighted for being adored in a sacrifice.

sa: तेषु संभक्ष्यमाणेषु प्रजा भयनिपीडिताः। यान्ति स्म शरणं शक्रं तमप्यर्थं न्यवेदयन्॥
en: On these having been devoured, creatures, afflicted with affright consequent on those having been eaten up, sought the shelter of Sakra and told him what had happened.

sa: अहो सुबलवान्रामो महदस्त्रबलं च वै। यस्य विक्रममासाद्य राक्षसा निधनं गताः॥
en: Alack! mighty must be Rāma and wondrous is or nor his strength of weapon-he coming in contact with whose prowess, these Rākşasas have met with their deaths.

sa: एतावदेव शेषं वो जेतव्यमिति वानराः। हताः सर्वे समागम्य राक्षसा बलदर्पिताः॥
en: This is the remaining force which you monkeys must conquer; all those Rākşasas, that had come forward, elated with the pride of strength, have all been slain.

sa: ननु त्वमिषुभिः कृद्धो भिन्द्याः कालान्तकावपि॥ मन्दरस्यापि शृङ्गाणि किं पुनर्लक्ष्मणं युधि।
en: Doubtless, you enraged could pierce with you arrows the Destroyer of Time himself, and the summit of Mandāra, what shall I say of Laks mana in encounted?

sa: ततोऽपरेण भल्लेन पीतेन निशितेन च। संपूर्णायतमुक्तेन सुपत्रेण सुवर्चसा ॥ महेन्द्राशनिकल्पेन सूतस्य विचरिष्यतः। स तेन बाणाशनिना तलशब्दानुनादिना ॥ लघवाद्राघवः श्रीमाशिरः कायादपाहरत्।
en: Then he hit at (Indrajit's) charioteer with another yellow and sharpened javelin splendid, furnished with feathers; and resembling the thunder-bolt of the great Indra. And through his fleet handedness the graceful son of Raghu with the thunder-bolt of his shaft, resonant with the sound of his palm, separated the (charioteer's head) from his trunk.

sa: अथेन्द्रशत्रु तरसा जघान बाणेन वज्राशनिसंनिभेन। भुजान्तरे व्यूढसुजातरूपे वज्रेण मेरुं भगवानिवेन्द्रः॥
en: Then as the reverend Indra cleave Meru with his thunder-bolt, (Raghava) swiftly smote on Rāvaņa's spacious and shapely chest with a shaft resembling Vajra and the thunderbolt.

sa: इत्येवमुक्तस्तु तदा महात्मा विभीषणेनारिविभीषणेन। ददर्श तं पर्वतसंनिकाशं रथस्थितं भीमबलं दुरासदम्॥
en: Thus accosted by Vibhīşaņa terrific to foes, that high-souled one saw (Indrajit) of dreadful prowess, difficult to gut at, and resembling a hill, stationed on his car.

sa: छिन्नं भिन्नं शरैर्दग्धं प्रभग्नं शस्त्रपीडितम्। बलं रामेण ददृशुर्न रामं शीघ्रकारिणम्॥
en: The all beheld the Råkşasas force scattered, wounded, burnt down with arrows, broken and assailed with weapons by Rāma But none could see the quick moving Rāma.

sa: इयं लङ्का पुरी राजनराक्षसानां महात्मनाम्॥ त्वया निवेशिता सौम्य नैतद्युक्तं तवानघ।
en: This city of Lankā, O king, belongs to the high-souled Rākṣasas; but you have established yourself in her. This, O sinless one, is not proper for you.

sa: अपगच्छत पश्यध्वं सीतामाप्नोति राघवः। घातयेत् परमामर्षी युष्मान् सार्धं हि राक्षसैः॥
en: Do youtherefore fly at some distance, and will find that Rāghava shall regain Sītā. And exercised with ire he shall destroy you all along with the Raksasas.

sa: निर्दस्युरभवल्लोको नानर्थं कश्चिदस्पृशत्। न च स्म वृद्धा बालानां प्रेतकार्याणि कुर्वते॥
en: The people were saved from the thieves and there was no other trouble. And the old were not constrained to perform the funeral ceremonies of the children.

sa: पटहं चारुसर्वाङ्गी न्यस्य शेते शुभस्तनी। चिरस्य रमणं लब्ध्वा परिष्वज्येव कामिनी॥
en: Another damsel possessed of graceful limbs and a shapely bust, was lying down, hugging her kettle-drum, like a woman embracing her lover obtained after a long time.

sa: ततस्तदत्रं विनिहत्य राघवः प्रसह्य तद्रावणबाहुनिःसृतम्। मुदान्वितो दाशरथिर्महात्मा विनेदुरुच्चैर्मुदिताः कपीश्वराः ॥
en: The high-souled son of Dasartha-Rāghavahaving by his might destroyed that weapon discharged by Råvana's arms, was delighted; and the monkey-chiefs, filled with glee, began to emit shouts.

sa: तस्मिंस्तत: संयति जातहर्षे रणाय निर्गच्छति बाणपाणौ। मूंगाश्च रौद्रा बहुधा विनेदुः॥
en: And as he issued out for battle, greatly delighted, with arrows in his hands, all the quar'ers becai.e dark, and jackals began to set up terrible cries.

sa: पश्याद्य रामं सह लक्ष्मणेन मद्वाणनिर्भिनविकीर्णदेहम्। गतायुषं भूमितले शयानं शितैः शरैराचितसर्वगात्रम्॥
en: To-day behold Rāma along with Lakşmaņa with their bodies torn with my shafts, lying down lifeless on the ground, having their persons covered with my sharpened arrows!

sa: सागरस्येव मे वेगो मारुतस्येव मे गतिः। नैतद्दाशरथिर्वेद ह्यासादयति तेन माम्॥
en: My rush is like that of the sea, and my motion that of the wind. Dasaratha's son does not know this, and therefore does he approach sea.

sa: त्वां दृष्ट्वा प्रियवक्तारं सम्प्रहृष्यामि वानर। अर्धसंजातसस्येव वृष्टिं प्राप्य वसुंधरा ॥
en: Even as the Earth with corn half-way towards harvest is gladdened on receipt of showers, have I, O monkey, been gladdened on seeing you that speakest sweetly.

sa: संतुष्टा फलमूलेन भर्तृशुश्रूषणापरा। या परां भजते प्रीतिं वनेऽपि भवने यथा॥
en: And satisfied with fruits and roots and ever engaged in her husband's service, she lived in the forest as much delighted as she was in her house.

sa: चिन्तयित्वा मुहूर्तं तु नारदः प्रत्युवाच तम्। अस्ति राजन्महाद्वीपं क्षीरोदस्य समीपतः॥ तत्र ते चन्द्रसंकाशा मानवाः सुमहाबलाः। महाकाया महावीर्या मेघस्तनितनि:स्वनाः॥ महामात्रा धैर्यवन्तो महापरिघबाहवः। श्वेतद्वीपे मया दृष्टा मानवा राक्षसाधिप।॥ बलवीर्यसमोपेतान्यादृशास्त्वमिहेच्छसि। नारदस्य वचः श्रुत्वा रावणः प्रत्युवाच ह॥
en: Whereto, thinking for a moment, the celestial saint Nārada replied: "O king, there is an insular continent near the milky ocean. All the inhabitants that live there are gifted with strength-effulgent like the rays of the moon, huge-bodied, highly powerful and have a voice deep as the muttering of the clouds. They are all greatly beautiful, patient and have huge arms. O king of Rākşasas, I have seen in Swetadvipa such powerful men, as you do want to see on this earth.” Hearing the words of Narada, Ravana said.

sa: प्रेक्षमाणाश्चमूं तां च बभूवुर्भयविह्वलाः। ते तु धर्मात्मना दृष्टा राक्षसेन्द्रेण राक्षसाः॥
en: Seeing that host, they were overwhelmed with fear. And, while staying there, they, discovered by the righteous lord of Raksasas, Vibhisana, were sore harassed (by the monkeys).

sa: वरप्राप्ति पितुस्ते तु ज्ञात्वैश्वर्यं तपोबलात्। तपस्तप्तुं गता मेरुं भ्रातरः कृतनिश्चयाः॥
en: And learning that their father had received a boon by virtue of his power proceeding from asceticism, the brothers, firmly resolved, went to Meru for practising penances.

sa: स्निग्धेन्द्रनीलनीलं तु प्रांशुशैलोपमं महत्॥ केयूराङ्गदवैदूर्यमुक्ताहारस्रगुज्ज्वलम्। कान्तं विहारेष्वधिकं दीप्तं संग्रामभूमिषु॥ भात्याभरणभाभिर्यद्विद्युद्भिरिव तोयदः। तदेवाद्य शरीरं ते तीक्ष्णै कचरैश्चितम्॥ पुनर्दुर्लभसंस्पर्श परिष्वक्तुं न शक्यते।
en: (This your body) is cool green like Indranila, high like a huge mountain, and adorned with Keyūra, Angada, jewels and garlands of flowers. It was graceful in places of enjoyments and incapable of being looked at in the field of battle. It was brilliant, being decked with ornaments like to clouds accompanied by lightnings.

sa: शृणु चापि समादेशं यदहं प्रब्रवीमि ते। राक्षसेश हरीशस्त्वां वाक्यमाह समाहितम्॥
en: Do you hear of my mission-I do relate to you, O lord of Räkşasas, the message which the monkey chief has commanded me to communicate to you.

sa: दह्यमानं ततो दृष्ट्वा प्रासादं हरियूथपः। स राक्षसशतं हत्वा वज्रणेन्द्र इवासुरान्॥
en: Seeing that edifice in flames, the graceful monkey-leader, having slain having slain the hundred Rākṣasas, like Indra slaying Asuras with this thunderbolt, remaining in the sky, said,

sa: तत्तस्य वाक्यं ब्रुवतो निशम्य सगर्वितं रोषविवृद्धदोषम्। महोदरो नैऋतयोधमुख्यः कृताञ्जलिर्वाक्यमिदं बभाषे।८१॥
en: Hearing his words as he haughtily spoke thus with his spirit of insolence magnified by much, that foremost of the Nairta soldiers, Mahodara, with joined hands observed.

sa: ग्रहीतुकामं तं गृह्य रक्षसामीश्वरं हरिः। खमुत्पपात वेगेन कृत्वा कक्षावलम्बिनम् ॥
en: Getting hold of Rāvana, the lord of Rākşasas, desirous of catching him, (Vāli) and placing him under his arm-pit Vāli vehemently rose high up in the welkin.

sa: तत्स्थितं पर्वताग्रेषु निझरेषु गुहासु च। तरमाणं च तीर्णं च ततुकामं च सर्वशः॥ निविष्टं निविशच्चैव भीमनादं महाबलम्। तद्वलार्णवमक्षोभ्यं ददृशाते निशाचरौ ॥
en: The forces were on mountain-tops, by fountains and in caves. And those rangers of the night beheld those forces, some having already crossed, and some crossing, and some intent on doing so, and some having sat down and some sitting that mighty army sending terrific roars, that ocean of hosts incapable of being disturbed.

sa: रामस्य बाहुवीर्येण रक्षिता लक्ष्मणस्य च। सुखं पारे समुद्रस्य युध्येम विगतज्वराः॥
en: We would have, on the other side of the Ocean, well protected by the prowess of Rāma and Lakşmaņa, and freed from all disturbances, fought at pleasure.

sa: ते महाबाणवषैश्च शूलप्रासैः सुदारुणैः। हन्यमानाः सुराः सर्वे न व्यतिष्ठन्त संहताः।॥
en: Thereupon being assailed by a downpour of huge shafts, maces, Prāsas and diverse dreadful weapons, the celestials could not keep their ground upon the field of warfare.

sa: अथाब्रवीन्मुनि रामः कथं ते भ्रातरो भने। कीदृशं तु तदा ब्रह्मस्तपस्तेपुर्महाबलाः॥
en: Then Rāma spoke to the ascetic, O Brahmana, how did those exceedingly mighty brothers carry on austerities in that forest; and what kind of penances was theirs?

sa: यो हि भृत्यो नियुक्तः सन्भ; कर्मणि दुष्करे। कुर्यात्तदनुरागेण तमाहुः पुरुषोत्तमम्॥
en: That servant who, being entrusted with a hard task, after having accomplished it, do another work in pursuance of (the prescribed business), is the best of men.

sa: स शङ्खनिनदैः पूर्णैर्भेरीणां चापि नि:स्वनैः। जगाम त्रिदशेन्द्रारिराजिं वेगेन वीर्यवान् ॥
en: All sides were filled with the blares of conchs and the sounds of kettle-drums. And then that enemy of the lord of celestials marched forth with impetuosity.

sa: द्वाभ्यामूर्ध्वं तु मासाभ्यां भर्तारं मामनिच्छतीम्। मम त्वां प्रातराशार्थे सूदाश्छेत्स्यन्ति खण्डशः॥
en: Even then if you do refuse to regard me as your husband, my cooks shall mince your limbs with steel and serve you for my morning meal.

sa: द्रक्ष्यामि नगरी लङ्कां साट्टप्राकारतोरणाम्। इत्यर्थमिह सम्प्राप्तः परं कौतूहलं हि मे॥
en: I will behold the city of Lanká, crowned with turrets, walls and ornamented arches. It is for this that I have come here, Great is my curiosity.

sa: दृष्ट्वैव तु राथस्थं तं पर्यवर्तत तद्बलम्। रक्षसां भीमवेगानां लक्ष्मणेन युयुत्सताम्॥
en: As soon as they saw him mounted on his car, that host of Rākşas possessed of dreadful impetuosity, eager to engage with Lakşmaņa, stood on their ground.

sa: तथा विराटनगरे श्रूयते महदद्भुतम्। एकस्य च बहूनां च पर्याप्तं तन्निदर्शनम्॥
en: In the same way in the city of Virata is heard a very strange tale in the fight of one against many; that is a sufficient proof.

sa: कर्मणानेन केनासि कापथं प्रतिपादितः। सुखसुप्तस्य ते राजन् प्रहृतं केन मूर्धनि॥
en: Who (intends) to lead you astray by imposing on you such a deed? Who, O king, has struck in the head, you that was slumbering in peace?

sa: एवमुक्तस्तव सुतो निर्जगाम जनेश्वर। अभिवाद्य गुरुं मूर्धा प्रययौ स्वं निवेशनम्॥
en: This spoken to, your son, O ruler of men, came out and saluting the reverend signor, with his head, he (your son) replied to his own tent.

sa: दीपानां च प्रकाशेन तेजसा रावणस्य च। अर्चिभिभूषणानां च प्रदीप्तेत्यभ्यमन्यत ॥
en: And (Hanumān) conceived that (Rāvana's sleeping apartment) was in a conflagration, on account of the display of the lamps, Rāvana's energy, and the splendour of the ornaments.

sa: मान्धातोवाच दृश्यन्ते मानुषे लोके सर्ववर्णेषु दस्यवः। लिङ्गान्तरे वर्तमाना आश्रमेषु चतुर्ध्वपि॥
en: Mandhatri said In this world, such wicked men may be seen living in disguise among all the four castes and in all the four modes of life.

sa: मातले कश्चिदत्रापि रुचिरस्ते वरो भवेत्। अथवान्यां दिशं भूमेर्गच्छाव यदि मन्यसे॥
en: See, O Matali, in these regions if there is a bridegroom who is to your liking or else we shall go to another direction of this earth.

sa: नित्यमग्निं परिचरेद् भिक्षां दद्याच्च नित्यदा। वाग्यतो दन्तकाष्ठं च नित्यमेव समाचरेत्॥
en: One should attend every day to his sacred fire. One should every day give alms. One should, controlling speech the while, clean his teeth with the tooth-stick.

sa: हाहाकारो महाञ्जज्ञे योधानां तव भारत। तिष्ठ तिष्ठेति चाप्यासीद् द्रावितानां महात्मनाम्॥
en: Exclamations of Oh and Alas, O Bharata, arose from among your warriors while some illustrious Kshatriyas among the dispersed combatants, desirous of victory, cried out, saying-stop, stop.

sa: उत्तरे दिवसे ब्रह्मन् फल्गुनीभ्यां मनीषिणः। वैवाहिकं प्रशंसन्ति भगो यत्र प्रजापतिः॥
en: The learned consider bridal celebrated on the day succeeding those on which the Phalgunis are on the ascendant, and having for its presiding deity Bhagas-the most auspicious.

sa: अथोवाच भरद्वाजो भरतं प्रहसन्निव। जाने त्वां प्रीतिसंयुक्तं तुष्येस्त्वं येन केनचित्॥
en: Then Bharadvāja as if in jest, said to Bharata, "I know you to be of a complacent disposition; and that you are pleased with anything and everything."

sa: आपत्संशयिता श्रेयो नात्र निःसंशयीकृता। प्रतिलोमानुलोमं वा यत्तु नो मन्यसे हितम्॥
en: In this matter, your being slain is uncertain, but victory is certain. Now do you, as you weigh out welfare, declare yourself for or against this course.

sa: ते चेदभिनिवेक्ष्यन्ते नाभ्युपैष्यन्ति मे वचः। कुरवो युद्धमेवात्र घोरं कर्म भविष्यति॥
en: If however they stick to their resolve and not listen to my advice, in that case there will be a terrible war among the sons of Kuru.

sa: तमुवाचगुर्वर्थं कुण्डलयोरर्थेनाभ्यागतोऽस्मीति। ये वै ते क्षत्रियया पिनद्धे कुण्डले ते भवान्दातु-मर्हतीति॥
en: Uttanka replied, “I have come to beg from you your queen's ear-rings as a Dakshina to be given to my preceptor. You should give me those ear-rings."

sa: इमौ स्म मुनिशार्दूल किंकरौ समुपागतौ। आज्ञापय मुनिश्रेष्ठ शासनं करवाव किम्॥
en: These servants of yours, O best of ascetics, have come before you. Do you command, O chief of anchorites, what command of your are we to execute

sa: ते तं प्रणम्य शिरसा प्रोचुः प्राञ्जलयस्तदा॥ किमप्यङ्कगतं ब्रह्मन् पार्वत्या भूतमद्भुतम्।
en: Then the gods bowing their heads down to Brahma addressed him, with folded arms, thus-"O Brahma, what wonderful creature is now lying on the lap of Parvati?

sa: भीष्म उवाच असकृत् प्रोच्यमानापि गौतमी भुजगं प्रति। लुब्धकेन महाभागा पापे नैवाकरोन्मतिम्॥ ईषदुच्छ्वसमानस्तु कृच्छ्रात् संस्तभ्य पन्नगः। उत्ससर्ज गिरं मन्दां मानुषीं पाशपीडितः॥
en: Bhishma said Although repeatedly urged on by the fowler for the destruction of the serpent, the great Gautami did nor bend her mind to that sinful deed. Painfully fettered with the cord, sighing a little and keeping up its composure with great difficulty, the serpent then uttered these words slowly, in a human voice.

sa: नोक्तपूर्वं मया मिथ्या स्वैरेष्वपि कदाचन। न च युद्धात् परावृत्तस्तथा संजीवतामयम्॥
en: Never before have I uttered a falschood even in just. Never have I turned back from battle. (By the merit of those deeds) let this child revive.

sa: तेनास्य मातापितरौ त्रेसतुस्तौ सबान्धवौ। वैकृतं तस्य तौ दृष्ट्वा त्यागायाकुरुतां मतिम्॥
en: His father and mother along with all their relatives were struck with fear (on seeing this fearful phenomenon). seeing these evil omens, they resolved to abandon him.

sa: पितुर्नियोगाज्जग्राह शुको धर्मभृतां वरः। योगशास्त्रं च निखिलं कापिलं चैव भारत॥
en: At the command of his father, Shuka, that foremost of all righteous men, mastered all the books on Yoga, O Bharata, as also the Science of Kapila.

sa: आत्मकीये वरारोहे शयनीये चतुर्दशीम्। अष्टमी वा ऋतुस्नाता संविशेथा मया सह॥
en: O beautiful featured lady, lie down with me on your bed on the eighth or the fourteenth day of the moon after the bath of your season.

sa: एवं ब्रुवति काकुत्स्थे विश्वामित्रो महातपाः। संहारान् व्याजहाराथ धृतिमान् सुव्रतः शुचिः॥
en: Upon Kākutstha's representing this, Viśvāmitra of high austerities, endowed with patience, of excellent vows, and pure in spirit, communicated to him the mantras for restraining the weapons.

sa: जयद्रथेन पापेन यत् कृष्णा केशिता वने॥ यातेषु मृगयां चैव तृणबिन्दोरथाश्रमम्।
en: Through the sinful Jayadratha again, Krishna was on another occasion insulted when the Pandavas, her lords, had gone out a thunting towards the hermitage of Trinavindu! you

sa: कनिष्ठिकायाः पश्चात् तु देवतीर्थमिहोच्यते॥ अङ्गुष्ठस्य च यन्मध्यं प्रदेशिन्याश्च भारत। तेन पित्र्याणि कुर्वीत स्पृष्ट्वापो न्यायतः सदा॥ परापवादं न ब्रूयानाप्रियं च कदाचन।
en: On the back of the little finger, it is said, is situate the Devatirtha. The intervening space between the thumb and the forefinger, Bharata, should be used for performing the Pitri rites, after touching water according to the ordinance. One should never vilify other people. Nor should one ever utter anything that is disagreeable.

sa: अभिमन्युश्च यद् बाल एको बहुभिराहवे॥ त्वद्दोषैनिहतः पाप तस्मादसि हतो रणे।
en: Causing Abhimanyu, who was a child and alone, to be surrounded by many, you did kill that hero. For this sin, O sinful wretch, you are slain!

sa: अग्नितीर्थं ततो गच्छेत् तत्र स्नात्वा नरर्षभ। अग्निलोकमवाप्नोति कुलं चैव समुद्धरेत्॥
en: O best of men, one should then go to the Tirtha called Agni. Bathing there, one goes to the region of Agni and saves his own race.

sa: ये चान्येऽपि परिक्लेशा युष्माकं ज्ञातिकारिताः। संग्रामेष्वथ वान्यत्र न तान् संस्मर्तुमर्हसि॥
en: You should not remember the other miseries which you suffered for the deeds of your kinsinen-the miseries, viz., that were due to battle or to other situations.

sa: न चैषां पुरुषाः केचिदायुधानि गदाः शरान्। विषहन्ति सदा कर्तुमधिज्यान्यपि कौरव॥
en: No human being can bear their weapons, maces and arrows, none can even adjust the string at the time of using the bow, O son of Kuru.

sa: तदभूत् तुमुलं युद्धं वृष्णिपार्षतयो रणे। आमिषार्थे यथा युद्धं श्येनयोः क्रुद्धयोप॥
en: Then there took place a terrible and wonderful encounter between the Vrishnis and Parsatas like that of two angry hawks, O king, for a piece of meat.

sa: द्रोणास्त्रमभिहत्यैष विमर्दे मधुसूदन। महेष्वासो हतः शेते नद्या हत इव दुमः॥
en: Having counteracted many weapons of Drona, this destroyer of foes, O slayer of Madhu, this great bowman lies there, dead, like a tree uprooted by the wind.

sa: पन्थानं हि ममाभीक्ष्णमाख्यासि च नरोत्तम। अतो निमित्तं शोकं मे वर्धयस्यमरोपम॥
en: O foremost of men! you are repeatedly instructing me about the road. O divine one! it is in this way that you are adding to my sorrow.

sa: स हि भगवानिन्द्रो मम सखा त्वदनुक्रोशादिममनुग्रहं कृतवान्। तस्मात्कृण्डले गृहीत्वा पुनरागतोऽसि॥
en: Lord Indra is my friend; he, being moved by kindness towards you, showed you this favour; therefore, you have been able to return safely with the ear-rings.

sa: एवं बुद्धिं समास्थाय दिवसानेकविंशतिम्। सुप्तोऽस्मि यदि मां कश्चिद् बोधयेदिति पार्थिव॥
en: It was with this resolution that I slept for twentyone days in the hope that somebody would awake me before I arose out of my own accord.

sa: ततो भीमो रणे क्रुद्धो रभसश्च विशेषतः। गजानीकं समासाद्य प्रेषयामास मृत्यवे॥
en: Thereafter Bhima inflamed with rage, fell with impetuosity upon the elephant-division of the Kurus, and many were the beasts that he sent to the regions of Death.

sa: स्ते पाण्डवानां प्रवरां रथौघाः। नादं च चक्रुर्भृशमुत्स्मयन्तः शङ्खांश्च दध्मुः शसिसंनिकाशान्॥
en: Beholding that feat of Bhima, all the foremost car-warriors among the Pandavas were filled with joy. Laughing aloud, they uttered terrible roars and blew their moonwhite conchs.

sa: विद्युत्पताकाः सबलाकमालाः शैलेन्द्रकूटाकृतिसंनिकाशाः। गर्जन्ति मेघाः समुदीर्णनादा मत्ता गजेन्द्रा इव संयुगस्थाः॥
en: The clouds, resembling the summits of a mountain, having lightnings for pennons and cranes for garlands, are muttering like to infuriated elephants in a field of battle.

sa: पूर्वं कृतयुगे राम दितेः पुत्रा महाबलाः। अदितेश्च महाभागा वीर्यवन्तः सुधार्मिकाः॥
en: Formerly in the Krita age, O Rāma, Diti's highly powerful sons, as well as those of Aditi, possessed of prowess, and virtuous and pious, high-souled ones both.

sa: ततो मुहूर्तात् तेऽपश्यन् रजो भीमं समुत्थितम्॥ विविधैः शोणितस्रावैः प्रशान्तं पुरुषर्षभ।
en: Soon it was seen that the cloud of dust was suppressed, O foremost of men, on account of the streams of blood that flowed on all sides.

sa: तत्र मासं वसेद्धीरः सरस्वत्यां युधिष्ठिर। यत्र ब्रह्मादयो देवा ऋषयः सिद्धचारणाः॥
en: O hero ever stcady in battle and should live there for a month where flows the Sarasvati. Brahma and other celestials, the Rishis, the Siddhas, the Charans.

sa: न मेऽस्त्यविदितं किंचिद् वनेऽस्मिंश्चरतः सदा। चतुरङ्ग ह्यतिबलं सुमहत् संतरेमहि ॥
en: Always ranging in this forest, nothing herein is unknown to me. I shall vanquish even any mighty body of fourfold forces (that may come up against us.)

sa: निर्याते तु जने तस्मिन् सागरो मकरालयः। द्वारकां रत्नसम्पूर्णो जलेनाप्लावयत् तदा॥
en: After all the people had started, the ocean, the home of sharks, and alligators, flooded Dwraka, which still teemed with riches of every kind, with its waters.

sa: तत्र मे याचितो राजा भरतस्याभिषेचनम्। गमनं दण्डकारण्ये तव चाद्यैव राघव॥
en: Of these two boons I have asked of the king the installation of Bharata, and the departure of Rāghava into the Dandaka forest even this very day.

sa: मम्लुर्माल्यानि देवानां नेशुस्तेजांसि चैव हि। उत्पातमेघा रौद्राश्च ववृषुः शोणितं बहु॥
en: The garlands in the necks of the celestials grew pale and dim and their splendour was lost. And terrible masses of clouds vomited thick showers of blood.

sa: तेन भग्नानरीन् सर्वान् मद्भग्नान् मन्यते जनः। तेन भग्नानि सैन्यानि पृष्ठतोऽनुव्रजाम्यहम्॥
en: People think that I rout my foes whereas they are really routed by him. I only pursue from behind the troops already broken and routed by him.

sa: आदौ तु वाचकं चैव वस्त्रगन्धसमन्वितम्। विधिवद् भोजयेद् राजन् मधु पायसमुत्तमम्॥
en: At first, the reciter, clad in good dresses, and smeared with perfumed paste, should, O king, be duly fed with honey and frumenty of the best kind.

sa: निरुक्तं वेदविदुषो वेदशब्दार्थचिन्तकाः। ते मां गायन्ति प्राग्वंशे अधोक्षज इति स्थितिः॥
en: Persons well-versed in the Vedas and engaged in interpreting the words used in those scriptures worship me in sacrifices by calling upon me by the same name.

sa: अब्रवीच्च तदा ब्रह्मा यथा त्वं धक्ष्यसेऽनल। खाण्डवं दावमद्यैव मिषतोऽस्य शचीपतेः॥
en: Then Brahma addressed him that I see a mcans by which you may consume Khandava today even before the very sight of the husband of Sachi (Indra).

sa: खङ्गधाराहता मेऽद्य दीप्यमाना इवाग्नयः। पतिष्यन्ति द्विषो भूमौ मेघा इव सविद्युतः॥
en: Being beheaded by my swords like to the flaming fire and besmeared with blood resembling the clouds with lightning, my enemies shall fall down to the ground.

sa: वै जीयमानान् विमनसो मामकान् विगतौजसः। वदसे संयुगे सूत दिष्टमेतन्न संशयः॥
en: You always speak of my warriors as depressed in mind, vanquished and shorn of energy in battle. O Suta, indubitably all this is brought about by Destiny.

sa: तेषां तद्वचनं श्रुत्वा देवानां विष्णुरब्रवीत्। मामेव यजतां शक्रः पावयिष्यामि वज्रिणम्॥
en: Hearing the words of the celestials Vişņu said, Let your Chief celebrate a sacrifice in my honour, and by that he shall be cleansed off the sin.

sa: ततः क्रोधाभिताम्राक्षो निर्दहन्निव पावकः। संदधे त्वाष्ट्रमस्त्रं स स्वयं त्वष्टेव मारुतिः॥
en: Then with his eyes coppery in rage and consuming the foe like fire itself, the son of Maruta invoked the Tvashtra weapon like the god Tvashtri himself.

sa: श्रीभगवानुवाच हन्त ते वर्तयिष्यामि पुराणं पाण्डुनन्दन। आत्मतेजोद्भवं पार्थ शृणुष्वैकमना मम॥
en: I shall recite to you, O son of Pandu, an ancient story of events arising from my own energy. Do you listen to it with concentrated mind.

sa: स्थितो ब्राह्मणधर्मेण ब्राह्मण्यमुपजीवति। क्षत्रियो वाथ वैश्यो वा ब्रह्मभूयं स गच्छति॥
en: If one who is a Kshatriya or Vaishya performs those duties which are assigned to the Brahmana, after the manner of a Brahmana, he becomes a Brahman.

sa: इन्द्रियाणां तथैवैषां सर्वेषामीश्वरं मनः। नियमे च विसर्गे च भूतात्मा मानसस्तथा॥
en: The mind is the lord of all these senses employing them in their functions and guiding controlling them. Likewise, the Understanding is the lord of the mind.

sa: तस्मिंस्तु निर्जिते राजन् राक्षसेन्द्रे महात्मना। अनादयन् सिंहनादैः पाण्डवाः सर्वतो दिशम्॥
en: Then, O king, when that foremost of the Rakshasas had been worsted by the illustrious Bhimasena, the Pandavas filled the quarters with the echoes of their war-cries.

sa: धृतराष्ट्र उवाच अहमप्येवमेवैतच्चिकीर्षामि यथा युवाम्। विवेक्तुं नाहमिच्छामि त्वाकारं विदुरं प्रति॥
en: Dhritarashtra said : I desire to act exactly as you desire, but I do not wish to show my mental thoughts to Vidura even by my demeanour.

sa: अशुचीश्च यदा क्रुद्धः क्षिणोति शतशो नरान्। सपुत्रपौत्रान् सामात्यांस्तदा भवति सोऽन्तकः॥
en: When he kills in anger hundreds of wicked men with their sons, grandsons, and relatives, he is then said to put on the form of the Destroyer.

sa: श्रद्दधानेन वै भव्यमेवमाह गुरुर्मम। वाचकस्य तु दातव्यं मनसा यद् यदिच्छति॥
en: A person listening with faith, becomes even so. My preceptor has said this. To the reciter should be given all such objects as he many wish. cars

sa: पत्यर्थं देवगर्भाभे मा वृथा यौवनं कृथाः। एवमुक्ता सुकन्यापि सुरौ ताविदमब्रवीत्॥
en: Making up your mind, invite your husband (from among us two). Do not spend your youth uselessly.” Having been thus addressed, Sukanya thus spoke to the celestials,

sa: तमापतन्तं त्वरितं गजेन्द्र धनंजयः कुम्भविभागमध्ये। आकर्णपूर्णेन महायसेन बाणेन विव्याध महाजवेन॥
en: Seeing him come quickly, Dhananjaya struck that elephant-chief on the head, between the temples, with a fierce iron shaft, discharged from the bow drawn to the ear.

sa: गच्छध्वं मुनयः सर्वे यथागतभितोऽचिरात्॥ न स शक्यस्त्वभक्तेन द्रष्टुं देवः कथंचन।
en: Go hence, ye Munis, to the place from where you have come! That great Deity is incapable of being ever seen by one who has no devotion.

sa: सद्यो हि गर्भान् राक्षस्यो लभन्ते प्रसवन्ति च। कामरूपधराश्चैव भवन्ति बहुरूपिकाः॥
en: The Rakshasas women give birth on the very day they conceive; they are capable of assuming any form at will and they change their forms (at will).

sa: सर्वथा सुकरं मित्रं दुष्करं प्रतिपालनम्। अनित्यत्वात् तु चित्तानां प्रीतिरल्पेऽपि भिद्यते॥
en: It is easy to contract friendship but very difficult to sustain it; for owing to the fickleness of our minds, a very slight cause bring about separation.

sa: सब्रह्मकाः सरुद्राश्च सेन्द्रा देवाः सहर्षिभिः॥ अर्चयन्ति सुरश्रेष्ठं देवं नारायणं हरिम्।
en: All the gods, including Brahman and Indra and the gods and the great Rishis, worship Narayana, that foremost of gods, otherwise called by the name of Hari.

sa: स मामनाथां विधवां नाद्य जानाति धार्मिकः। रामः कमलपत्राक्षो जीवनाशमितो गतः॥
en: That virtuous one does not know that to-day I have become helpless and been widowed. Răma of eyes resembling lotus-petals has living been removed from my sight.

sa: तच्छ्रुत्वा भगवान् क्रुद्धो यक्ष्माणां पृथिवीपते॥ ससर्ज रोषात् सोमाय त चोडुपतिमाविशत्।
en: Hearing those words, the worshipful Daksha, O king, became angry and imprecated the curse of phthisis upon Some. Thus did that disease affect the king of stars.

sa: पुत्रं तस्य महाराज ऋचीकं भृगुनन्दनम्। साक्षात् कृत्स्नो धनुर्वेदः समुपस्थास्यतेऽनघ।॥ क्षत्रियाणामभावाय दैवयुक्तेन हेतुना। स तु तं प्रतिगृह्मैव पुत्रे संक्रामयिष्यति॥ जमदग्नौ महाभागे तपसा भावितात्मनि। स चापि भृगुशार्दूलस्तं वेदं धारयिष्यति॥
en: He will have a son of the name of Richika. The whole science of arms, O sinless one, on its embodied form, will come to him, for the extermination of the entire Kshatriya caste, through a decree of Destiny. Receiving that science by inward light, he will, by Yogapower, communicate it to his son, the highly blessed Jamadagni of purified soul. That foremost of Bhrigu's race will bear that science in his mind.

sa: ओषधीनां क्षये जाते प्राणिनामपि संक्षयः॥ कृशाश्चासन् प्रजाः सर्वाः क्षीयमाणे निशाकरे।
en: And on account of the absence of the deciduous herbs, living creatures also began to die. Indeed, owing to the wasting of Soma, all creatures grew emaciated.

sa: ततः सूर्यं समुत्सृज्य राहुं फलमवेक्ष्य च। उत्पपात पुनर्योम ग्रहीतुं सिंहिकासुतम्॥
en: Thereupon leaving aside the sun and being desirous of holding Rāhu, the son of Siṁhikā considering him as a fruit, Hanumān again sprang up into the sky.

sa: वैशम्पायन उवाच एवमुक्तस्तथेत्याह वृषपर्वा महाकविः। देवयान्यन्तिकं गत्वा तमर्थ प्राह भार्गवः॥
en: Vaishampayana said : When the great son of Kavi (Shukra) was thus addressed by Vrishaparva, he went to Devayani and the son of Bhrigu told her all.

sa: कच्चिन्न तद्धेमसमानवणं तस्याननं पद्मसमानगन्धि। मया विना शुष्यति शोकदीनं जलक्षये पद्ममिवातपेन॥
en: Is not the gold-hued and lotus-smelling countenance (of Rāma) dried up my absence like to lotus dried up by the rays of the sun in shallow water?

sa: एवं ते द्रविडाऽऽभीरा: पुण्ड्राश्च शबरैः सह। वृषलत्वं परिगता व्युत्थानात् क्षत्रधर्मिणः॥
en: Thus the Dravidas and Adhiras and Pundars together with the Shavaras, became Vrishalas through those men who had Kshatriya duties assigned to them, following away (from them).

sa: तथा प्रजापतिर्ब्रह्मा अव्यक्तः प्रभुरव्ययः। येनेदं निखिलं विश्वं जनितं स्थावरं चरम्॥
en: The Lord of all creatures, Brahman, unmanifest, gifted with power, and of unfading glory, who created this vast universe with its mobile and immobile creatures, (is Brahmana).

sa: गोमन्तः पर्वतो राजन् सुमहान् सर्वधातुकः। यत्र नित्यं निवसति श्रीमान् कमललोचनः॥ मोक्षिभिः संगतो नित्यं प्रभुर्नारायणो हरिः। कुशद्वीपे तु राजेन्द्र पर्वतो विद्रुमैश्चितः॥
en: O king, there is the mountain called Gomanta which is huge in size and which consists of all kinds of metals. On its summit lives Narayana Hari with those they have obtained salvation, graced with prosperity and possessed of eyes like lotus. O great king, in Kushadvipa there is another mountain abounding in corals.

sa: प्रादुरास्तां ततस्तस्य करौ जलजसंनिभौ। ततः स विस्मितो भ्रातुर्दर्शयामास तौ करौ॥
en: Thereat, two hands, like two lotuses, appeared at the extremities of his stumps. Stricken with wonder he returned to his brother and showed him the two hands.

sa: (मस्य राज्ञश्च युधिष्ठिरस्य। निकृत्य रोक्मे पटुवर्मणी तयो विडदारयामास भुजौ महात्मा।॥
en: Cutting off the golden coats of mail of both Bhima and king Yudhishthira with nine arrows, the illustrious Shalya then struck the arins of both of them.

sa: यदि भूयो महाराज प्रजा इच्छस्युपासितुम्। वस वा वीर भद्रं ते एवमाह पितामहः॥ अथ वा विजिगीषा ते सुरलोकाय राघव। सनाथा विष्णुना देवा भवन्तु विगतज्वराः॥
en: O great king, do you wait in this land of mortals if do you wish to govern people for some time more. And if did you wish to repair to the region of immortals, do you again lord over the deities in your Vişņu form and let them be freed from anxiety. O Hero, the Patriarch has sent this intelligence to you.

sa: ते तु सर्वे द्विजश्रेष्ठाः पाण्डवानां हितेप्सया। मैवमित्यब्रुवन् भीमं गर्हयन्तोऽस्य साहसम्॥
en: And those best of the Brahmanas desirous of the welfare of the Pandavas, condemning the rashness of Bhima, told him not to do such an act again.

sa: ततः सर्वाणि सैन्यानि धर्मपुत्रस्य शासनात्। अभ्यद्रवन्त गाङ्गेयं मर्दयन्तं शितैः शरैः॥
en: Thereafter the whole army, by the order of the son of Dharma, rushed against the son of Ganga when the latter was wounding them with whetted shafts.

sa: यदधात यथा विप्रं कचमाङ्गिरसं तदा। अपापशीलं धर्मज्ञं शुश्रूषं मद्गृहे रतम्॥
en: As you killed the grandson of Rishi Angirasa, the Brahmana Kacha, who was virtuous, learned in religious precepts and attentive to duties, when he lived with me.

sa: कृच्छ्रे पूर्वं चानुभूय इतःप्रभृति कौरव। विहरस्व मया सार्धं गतशोको निरामयः॥
en: Having suffered a little misery first, from this time, O son of Kuru's race, do you sport with me in happiness, horn of grief and all ailments.

sa: सुद्युम्नश्चापि राजर्षिः श्रूयते दण्डधारणात्। प्राप्तवान् परमां सिद्धिं दक्षः प्राचेतसो यथा॥
en: It is heard again that the royal sage Sudyumna, only by wielding the rod of chastisement, gained the highest success, like Daksha himself, the son of Prachetas.

sa: वसत्यत्र सखा तस्य तक्षकः पन्नगः सदा। सगणस्तत्कृते दावं परिरक्षति वज्रभृत्॥
en: There lives in this forest) his friend the Naga Takshaka with his relatives and followers. It is for him that the wilder of thunder (Indra) protects it.

sa: जनमेजय उवाच अत्यद्भुतमिदं कर्म पार्थस्यामितेजसः। धृतराष्ट्रो महाप्राज्ञः श्रुत्वा विप्र किमब्रवीत्॥
en: Janamejaya said : These acts of the immeasurably effulgent Partha (Arjuna) are (no doubt) wonderful. O Brahmana, what did greatly wise Dhritarashtra say on hearing (all this)?

sa: इत्यासीत् तुमुलः शब्दः शोणाश्वस्य रथं प्रति। द्रोणमस्तु परमक्रुद्धो वायव्यारेण संयुगे॥
en: These (and similar other) tumultuous uproars arose near the car of Shonasva (i.e. Drona). Getting terribly enraged, Drona also, by means of Vayaveya weapon, in that encounter.

sa: तेन शब्देन वित्रस्ता धनुर्हस्ता महारथाः। धृष्टद्युम्नं हतं श्रुत्वा द्रौपदेया विशाम्पते॥
en: Terrified by the noise, and learning that Dhrishtadyumna had been killed those great car-warriors, viz., the sons of Draupadi, armed with bows, shot arrows on Drona's son.

sa: पापीयसः क्षमेतैव श्रेयसः सदृशस्य च। विमानितो हतोत्क्रुष्ट एवं सिद्धिं गमिष्यति॥
en: A sinful man should be forgiven as if he were righteous by one who is insulted, struck, and calumniated. By acting in this way one gains success.

sa: अभिमन्युश्च बलवान् द्रौपद्याः पञ्च चात्मजाः। स्वयं चापि समर्थोऽसि त्रैलोक्योत्सादनेऽपि च॥
en: And the powerful Abhimanyu, and the five sons of Draupadi are also at your service. And you to are alone capable of annihilating even the three words.

sa: यथाऽऽदित्यः समुद्यन् वै तमः पूर्वं व्यपोहति। एवं कल्याणमातिष्ठन् सर्वपापैः प्रमुच्यते॥
en: Thus seeking salvation, a man is freed from all his sins, even as the sun, upon rising, displays its lustre after it has driven off all darkness.

sa: ततः सत्रं समभवत् तस्य राज्ञो महात्मनः। यथाविधिः यथाकालं यथोक्तं बहुदक्षिणम्॥
en: Thereupon the sacrifice for which the illustrious king made preparations who performed according to the ordinance, at the proper season and a with large amount of Dakshinas.

sa: स वक्षसि पपातोग्रः शरो व्याल इव श्वसन्। महीं राजंस्ततश्चाहमगमं रुधिराविलः॥
en: That fierce shaft struck me on the breast hissing (through the air) like a serpent, and I fell down to the earth, O king, covered with blood.

sa: स चाप्यस्मिन्मखे सौते विद्वान् कुलपतिर्द्विजः। दक्षोधृतव्रतो धीमान् शास्त्रे चारण्यके गुरुः॥
en: O Sauti, that Kulapati Brahmana is the chief in this sacrifice; he is able, faithful to his vows, wise and a master of the Shastras and Aranyakas.

sa: आर्यामथेन वामेन राजानं दक्षिणेन च। अंसयोश्च यमौ कृत्वा पृष्ठे बीभत्सुमेव च॥ सहसोत्पत्य वेगेन सर्वानादाय वीर्यवान्। भ्रातृनार्यां च बलवान् मोक्षयामास पावकात्॥
en: Then taking the revered lady (his mother) on his left flank and the king (Yudhishthira) on the right, the twins on each shoulder and Vivatsu (Arjuna) on his back. The powerful hero (Bhima), taking all of them, cleared off the fire at one leap and thus delivered his mother and brothers from the conflagration.

sa: प्राद्रवन् सहसा सर्वे भीमसेनभयार्दिताः। अनुयायाच कौन्तेयः पुत्राणां ते महद् बलम्॥
en: Your sons, O ruler of men, began to desert their ranks; and afflicted with the fear of Bhima, they fled with all the speed at their command.

sa: कृतवर्मा मया वीरो निर्यास्यन्नेव वारितः। शाल्वं निवारयिष्येऽहं तिष्ठ त्वमिति सूतज॥
en: O son of Suta, when the heroic Kritavarma was coming out to meet Shalva, I made his desist, saying “I will resist him (Shalva). You better stay."

sa: आगन्ता मद्गहं तात वैदेहः सत्यसंगरः। अथाहं तं नियोक्ष्यामि तत् करिष्यत्यसंशयम्॥
en: The king of the Videhas, ever devoted to truth, will come to my residence soon. For sooth, he will do what I will request him to do.

sa: त्वयापीह महत् कर्म देवानां पुरुषर्षभ॥ कृतं भीमसहायेन यमाभ्यां च महाभुज।
en: By you also, O foremost of men, with Bhima for your helpmate and the twins, O mighty-armed hero, has the great work of the gods been done.

sa: स तद् बाणमयं वर्षमश्मवर्षमिवाचलः। प्रतीच्छन् पाण्डुदायादो न प्राव्यथत शत्रुहा॥ विन्दानुविन्दौ सहितौ सुवर्माणं च ते सुतम्। प्रहसन्नेव कौन्तेयः शरैर्निन्ये यमक्षयम्॥ ततःसुदर्शनं वीरं पुत्रं ते भरतर्षभ। विव्याध समरे तूर्ण स पपात ममार च॥ सोऽचिरेणैव कालेन तद्रथानीकमाशुगैः। दिशः सर्वाः समालोक्य व्यधमत् पाण्डुनन्दनः॥ ततो वै स्थघोषेण गर्जितेन मृगा इव। भज्यमानाश्च समरे तव पुत्रा विशाम्पते॥
en: Then they poured their arrows of Pandu's son of fearful deeds like clouds drenching the mountain breast with their contents at the end of summer. Like a mountain receiving a shower of stones, the son of Pandu then received that arrowy shower and that slayer of foes was none the less worse for it. Then the son of Kunti, as if smiling, dispatched with his arrows, Vinda and Anuvinda together with Suvarman to the abode of death. Then, O foremost of the Bharatas, he pierced in battle, your heroic son Sudarsana, who fell down and died on the spot. Then in no time, the son of Pandu, casting his eyes on all directions, began to agitate that car-host with his (fierce) arrows. Then like a herd of deer, terrified at the loud clatter of ear-wheels.

sa: एवं वसिष्ठापवाहो लोके ख्यातो जनाधिप॥ आगच्छच्च पुनर्मार्ग स्वमेव सरितां वरा॥
en: For this reason, O king, the tirtha passed by the name of Vashishthapavaha on Earth. The best of rivers, however, once more regained her own proper condition.

sa: अर्थेन हि विहीनस्य पुरुषस्याल्पमेधसः। विच्छिद्यन्ते क्रियाः सर्वा ग्रीष्मे कुसरितो यथा।॥
en: The acts of a person who, endued with little intelligence allows himself to be divested of wealth, are all dried up like shallow rivers in the summer.

sa: पाञ्चजन्यरवो घोरः पुनरासीद् विशाम्पते। तं श्रुत्वा निनदं घोर त्रैलोक्यत्रासनं महत्॥
en: The fierce blare of the conch Panchajannya, O ruler of men, was once more heard. Hearing that dreadful blast capable of inspiring terroi into the three worlds.

sa: वैशम्पायन उवाच एवमुक्त्वा महात्मानमात्मा कृष्णस्य पाण्डवः। तूष्णीमासीत् ततः पार्थमित्युवाच जनार्दनः॥
en: Vaishampayana said : Having spoken thus to Krishna, the highsouled Pandava (Arjuna) who was his (Krishna's) soul became dumb. Janardana (Krishna) then thus replied to Partha (Arjuna).

sa: चिन्तयन्ती बहुविधं हृदयेन विदूयता। बलाबलं च मन्त्राणां ब्राह्मणस्य च वाग्बलम्॥
en: With diverse thoughts and fearing in my heart and reflecting on the strength or weakness of the incantation as also of the efficacy of the Brahmana's boon.

sa: सम्मानयेत् पूजयेच्च वाचा नित्यं च कर्मणा। कुर्याच्च प्रियमेतेभ्यो नाप्रियं किञ्चिदाचरेत्॥
en: One should, for this reason, always honour and adore his kinsmen in words and deeds, and are do what pleases them without injuring them at any time.

sa: स तु विप्रः प्रशान्तश्च स्पृष्टः पुण्येन वायुना। सुखमासाद्य सुष्वाप भास्करश्चास्तमभ्ययात्॥
en: Fanned by that sweet-scented breeze, the Brahmana became refreshed, and for the pleasure he felt ho soon fell asleep. Meanwhile the sun set behind the setting hills.

sa: तं चेन्न यजसे राजन् प्राप्तस्त्वं राज्यकिल्बिषम्। येषां राजाऽश्वमेधेन यजते दक्षिणावता॥
en: Those subjects whose king performs a horse-sacrifice with enough presents, are all freed from sins and sanctified by witnessing the ablutions at the end of the sacrifice.

sa: मध्ये च हृदयस्यैका शिरा तत्र मनोवहा। शुक्र संकल्पजं नृणां सर्वगात्रैर्विमुञ्चति॥
en: There is a channel leading to the heart called Manovaha. It draws from every part of the human body the seminal fluid which is born of desire.

sa: एतद् धर्मफलं पुत्र नराणां धर्मनिश्चये। यत् तुष्यन्त्यस्य पितरो माता चाप्येकदर्शिनी॥
en: It is certainly the duty of men inclined to virtue, my son, to gratify one's father and mother who alone can view things in their proper light.

sa: नकुलः सहदेवश्च तथेमौ गुरुवर्तिनौ। क्षुधा कथं न सीदेतामिति चोद्धर्षणं कृतम्॥
en: I instilled courage into your hearts so that Nakula and Sahadeva, who are always devoted to their elders, may not be weakened and rendered cheerless by hunger.

sa: त्वकृते निहतः शेते शरतल्पे महायशाः। गाङ्गेयो भरतश्रेष्ठः सर्वेषां नः पितामहः॥
en: It is for you that, that illustrious chief of the Bharatas, the son of Ganga, the grandfather of us all, lies now on a bed of arrows.

sa: अथ त्वरन् कर्णवधाय पार्थो महेन्द्रवज्रानलदण्डसंनिभम्। आदत्त चाथाञ्जलिकं निषङ्गात् सहस्ररश्मेरिव रश्मिमुत्तमम्॥
en: Then wishing to kill Karna quickly Arjuna took out from his quiver an Anjlika arrow that was effulgent like Indra's thunder-bolt, Agni's rod or the thousand-rayed sun.

sa: एतत् तवैवानुरूपं कमार्जुन महाहवे॥ दिवि वा देवराजस्य त्वया यत् कृतमाहवे।
en: O Arjuna, deeds that had been wrought by you today in this dreadful battle are proper for you, or for the lord of the celestials in heaven.

sa: ब्राह्मणः ऊचुः क्रियतामुपहारोऽद्य त्र्यम्बकस्य महात्मनः। दत्त्वापहारं नृपते ततः स्वार्थं यतामहे।।।।
en: Let offerings be made to the great Mahadeva of three eyes. eyes. Having duly dedicated those offerings, O king, we shall then try to gain our objet.

sa: आरुजन् विरुजन् पार्थो ज्यां विकर्षश्च पाणिना। सम्प्रकर्षन् विमर्षश्च सेनाग्रं समलोडयत्॥
en: Drawing and rubbing and stretching with his hands the string of his bow, that son of Pritha began to crush and kill the vanguard of the enemy.

sa: एतच्छ्रुत्वा तु राजाऽसौ प्राग्दीक्षाकालमब्रवीत्। क्षत्तारं न हि मे कश्चिदज्ञातः प्रविशेदिति॥
en: Having heard this, the king, before he was installed in the sacrifice, ordered the gate keepers, saying, “None must be allowed to enter here without my permission."

sa: तस्या रूपेण स गिरिवेषण च विशेषतः। स सवृक्षक्षुपलतो हिरण्मय इवाभवत्॥
en: I consequence of the beauty and splendour of that maiden the mountain itself with its creepers and plants appeared as if it has been converted into gold.

sa: जनमेजय उवाच त्वत्तः श्रुतमिदं ब्रह्मन् देवदानवरक्षसाम्। अंशावतरणं सम्यग् गन्धर्वाप्सरसां तथा॥
en: Janamejaya said : O Brahmana, I have heard in detail the account of the births of the Devas, the Danavas, the Rakshasas, the Gandharvas and the Apsaras.

sa: तदद्भुततरं श्रुत्वा देव्या वरमनुत्तमम्॥ संप्रहृष्टमना भूत्वा राजा वाक्यमथाब्रवीत्। यदि देवि प्रसन्ना मे रूपेणाप्रतिमा भुवि॥ मासं स्त्रीत्वमुपासित्वा मासं स्यां पुरुषः पुनः।
en: Hearing of that excellent and wondrous boon the king became greatly delighted and said:-If you are pleased with me, O goddess, do you confer upon me this boon, that I may be for one month, a female gifted with wonderful beauty in the three worlds and for another month I may be a male.

sa: मन्दपाल उवाच न स्त्रीणां विद्यते किंचिदमुत्र पुरुषान्तरात्। सापत्नकमृते लोके नान्यदर्थविनाशनम्॥
en: Mandapala said : As regards woman, there is nothing that destroys their happiness more in this or the next world than a co-wife and a clandestine lover.

sa: तथेति च प्रतिज्ञाय रामो लक्ष्मणमब्रवीत्। द्वारि तिष्ठ महाबाहो प्रतिहारं विसर्जय॥
en: There upon Rāma promised that it should be done and said to Lakşmaņa:-O you having long arms, sending away the warder do you wait at the gate.

sa: सोऽमात्यैः स्थविरैः सार्धं ब्राह्मणैश्च महर्षिभिः। बलेन चतुरङ्गेण ययौ मद्रपतेः पुरम्॥
en: Accompanied by the aged ministers Brahmanas and great Rishis and with a force of the four kinds he went to the capital of the king of Madra.

sa: त्वं पवित्र सदा लोके सर्वभूतगतिश्च ह। न त्वं सर्वशरीरेण सर्वभक्षत्वमेष्यसि॥
en: You are always pure in the Universe, you are the stay of all creatures. You shall not be the eater of all things with all your body,

sa: तं स्थाणुभूतं तिष्ठन्तं क्षुत्पिपासाश्रमातुरः। पुनः पुनर्पगं नष्टं पप्रच्छ पितरं तव॥
en: But he (your father) was then observing the vow of silence. Oppressed by hunger, thirst and fatigue, the king repeatedly asked your father about the missing deer.

sa: अक्षतः शस्त्रसम्पन्नो जितारिः सह राजभिः। रथमास्थाय तं दिव्यं निर्जगाम गिरिव्रजात्॥
en: Unwounded, (now) with (many) weapons, vanquishing the foe, he (Krishna), riding on the celestials car (of Jarasandha) came out with the kings from the city of Girivraja.

sa: स तप्यमानः पुत्रार्थे लपितामिदमब्रवीत्। कथं नु शक्ताः शरणे लपिते मम पुत्रकाः॥ वर्धमाने हुतवहे वाते चाशु प्रवायति। असमर्था विमोक्षाय भविष्यन्ति ममात्मजाः॥
en: Being very much anxious for his sons, he spoke thus to Lapita, my children are not now in possession of the power of moving, how are they (now)? When the fire will grow in strength and when the wind will begin to blow run with violence, my children will be incapable of saving themselves.

sa: ईप्सितं यादृशं तुभ्यं सज्जये यावदायुधन्। तमुवाचाशु शत्रुघ्नः क्व मे जीवन्गमिष्यसि॥
en: Do you remain here as long as I with that shall not kill you. Where to Satrughna immediately replied Where shall you go while I am alive?

sa: कदाचिदपि मत्सीं तां बबन्धुर्मत्स्यजीविनः। मासे च दशमे प्राप्ते तदा भरतसत्तम॥
en: Some time after, this fish (Adrika) was caught by the fisherinen. O best of the Bharata race, it was the tenth month after she swallowed the seed.

sa: ते भीताः समकम्पन्त तस्य पक्षानिलाहताः। नो भञ्ज्यादिति तदा दिव्याः कनकशाखिनः॥
en: Struck by the wind raised by his wings, the trees began to tremble in fear. Those trees, with golden boughs, feared that they would be broken down.

sa: ते वै रत्नभुजं कृष्णं रत्नार्हाः पृथिवीश्वराः। राजानश्चक्रुरासाद्य मोक्षिता महतो भयात्॥
en: Having been freed from their great fear, those monarchs, those kings, those possessors came of gems came to Krishna and presented him with many gems and jewels.

sa: आदीष्य जातुषं वेश्म दग्ध्वा चैव पुरोचनम्। प्राद्रवन्भयसंविग्ना मात्रा सह परंतपाः॥
en: They then set fire to the house of lac and burnt Purochana. They, those chastisers of foes, then fled with their mother in anxiety and in fear.

sa: अन्वारुरोह चाप्येनं प्रेम्णा राजा युधिष्ठिरः। अपास्य चास्य यन्तारं दारुकं यन्तृसत्तमम्॥ अभीषून् सम्प्रजग्राह स्वयं कुरुपतिस्तदा। उपारुह्यार्जुनश्चापि चामरव्यजनं सितम्॥ रुक्मदण्डं बृहद्वाहुर्विदुधाव प्रदक्षिणम्।
en: The king of the Kurus, Yudhishthira, ascended the chariot after him (Krishna), and out of love for him he made that best of charioteers (Dwarka) to stand aside, and himself took the reins. The long-armed Arjuna walked round him (Krishna) and he then got on the car and waved a golden-handled Chamara over him.

sa: क्लान्तः शत्रुर्न कौन्तेय लभ्यः पीडयितुं रणे। पीड्यमानो हि कात्स्न्येन जह्याज्जीवितमात्मनः॥
en: Krishna said O son of Kunti, the foe that has become tried in the fight.cannot be pressed. If pressed at such a time, he may even die.

sa: ते त देवा भयोद्विग्ना: काव्यादुशनसस्तदा। ऊचुः कथमुपागम्य ज्येष्ठं पुत्रं बृहस्पतेः॥
en: Thereupon, the celestials, in great anxiety and in fear of the learned Ushanas, went to Kacha, the eldest son of Brihaspati; and they spoke to him thus.

sa: ऋषय ऊचुः द्वैपायनेन यत् प्रोक्तं पुराणं परमर्षिणा। सुरैर्ब्रह्मर्षिभिश्चैव श्रुत्वा यदभिपूजितम्॥
en: The Rishis replied The Purana which was told by the illustrious sage, Dvaipayana and which was greatly esteemed by the celestials and Brahmarshis when they heared it,

sa: ब्रह्मचारी विनीतात्मा जटिलो बहुलः समाः। अवसं सुचिरं तत्र गुरुशुश्रूषणे रतः॥
en: I was engaged there in serving my preceptor and lived (with him) for a long time as an humble minded Brahmachari with matted locks on my head.

sa: मम मोतृष्वसुर्धाता रावणो नाम राक्षसः। हतो रामेण दुर्बुद्धे स्त्रीहेतोः पुरुषाधम॥
en: The Räksasa Rāvana was the brother of my aunts. O you of vicious understanding, O vile wight, it is for his wife that Rāma did slay him.

sa: तेन चढूंषि वस्ताता व्यक्त कोपान्महात्मना। स्मरता निहतान् बन्धूनादत्तानि न संशयः॥
en: O children, there is no doubt your eyesight has been destroyed by this high-souled (Garbha) whose wrath has been kindled on remembering the massacre of his race.

sa: सारथिं चाब्रवीत् क्रुद्धो याहि यत्रैष पार्थिवः। यावदेनं निहन्म्यद्य भुजङ्गमिव पक्षिराट्॥
en: He (Bhishma) commanded his charioteer in anger, saying, “ Lead the car where the king (Shalva) is. I shall instantly kill him as Garuda kills a serpent."

sa: एवं स गुणसम्पन्नो धर्मार्थकुशलो नृपः। आसीद् भरतवंशस्य गोप्ता सर्वजनस्य च॥
en: That king endued with such accomplishments. He was learned in both Dharma and Artha. He was both the protector of the Bharata race and all the people,

sa: पित्रा त्यक्ता तथा मात्रा भ्रात्रा चाहमसंशयम्। दुःखाद् दुःखतरं प्राप्य म्रियेयमतथोचिता॥
en: Having been abandoned by my father brother and also my mother, I shall fall from misery to greater misery and I shall finally perish in great distress.

sa: तौ ते ददृशुरासक्तौ विकर्षन्तौ परस्परम्। काडक्षमाणौ जयं चैव सिंहाविव बलोत्कटौ॥
en: They saw those two (Bhima and Hidimba) already engaged in fight; they were dragging each other, (both) eager to overcome each other like two greatly strong lions.

sa: योष दर्पाद्धर्षाद् वाप्यथ ब्राह्मणचापलात्। प्रस्थितो धनुरायन्तुं वार्यतां साधु मा गमत्॥
en: Therefore stop this Brahmana and prevent him from attempting to string the bow, which he (surely) desires to do out of vanity, childish daring and mere restlessness.

sa: भगवन्किप्रमाणेन मम वंशो भविष्यति। किमायुश्च हि मे रामः पुत्राश्चान्ये किमायुषः॥
en: O illustrious Sir, how long shall my family remain in existence? What is the extent of the lease of life granted to Rāma and my other sons?

sa: उपहारैर्वञ्चयित्वा वर्मन्येव सुयोधनः। वरदं तं वरं वत्रे साहाय्यं क्रियतां मम॥
en: Having deceived him on the way by present. Duryodhana induced him to grant him a boon and for that boon he asked his help in the war.

sa: षडना महाराज कच्चित् ते पृष्ठतः कृताः। निद्राऽऽलस्यं भयं क्रोधोऽमार्दवं दीर्घसूत्रता॥
en: O great king, have you banished from you the six evils (to which human flesh is heir to), namely sleep, fear, anger, weakness of mind and procrastination?

sa: वीर कुरुराजेति ही भीम इति जल्पताम्। पुरुषाणां सुविपुलाः प्रणादाः सहसोत्थिताः॥
en: Some cried, “Behold the heroic Kuru prince; some cried, “Behold the heroic Bhima.” Thus from these cries of the people rose a great uproar (in the arena).

sa: रक्षसा विप्रमुक्तोऽथ स नृपस्तददू वनं महत्। तेजसा रञ्जयामास संध्याभ्रमिव भास्करः॥
en: Having been thus freed froin the Rakshasas by that Brahmana (Vasishtha) the king illuminated the great forest by his splendour, as the sun illuminates the evening clouds.

sa: नाक्रामन्त यदा शापा बाणा मुक्ताः शिलास्विव। नियमान् सम्परित्यज्य व्यद्रवन्त द्विजातयः॥
en: When the Brahmanas saw that their curses make no impressions on them like arrows shot at stones, they fled in all directions, forsaking their rites and vows.

sa: यदि दत्तं यदि हुतं विद्यते यदि नस्तपः। तेन तिष्ठन्तु नगरे पाण्डवाः शरदां शतम्॥ ततस्ते धृतराष्र्ण्य भीष्मस्य च महात्मनः। अन्येषां च तदर्हाणां चक्रुः पादाभिवन्दनम्॥
en: If we have ever given away in charity, if we have ever poured libations of ghee on the (sacrificial) fire, if we have any ascetic merit, let the Pandavas live in our city for one hundred years." They (the Pandavas) worshipped the feet of Dhritarashtra, as also those of Bhishma and also the feet of every body else that deserved the honour.

sa: वैशम्पायन उवाच एवमुक्तस्तया राजा तां देवीं पुनरब्रवीत्। धर्मविद् धर्मसंयुक्तमिदं वचनमुत्तमम्॥
en: Vaishampayana said : Having been thus addressed, the king (Pandu), learned in the precepts of religious spoke these words of virtuous import to that lady (his wife).

sa: राजोवाच यन्मयापकृतं मोहादज्ञानादृषिसत्तम। प्रसादये त्वां तत्राहं न मे त्वं क्रोद्भुमर्हसि।॥
en: The king said : O best of Rishis, I have offended you out of ignorance. I beseech you, pardon me. You should not be angry with me.

sa: भवतां च विजानामि सर्वलोकहितेप्सुताम्। तस्माद् विधध्वं यच्छ्रेयो लोकानां मम चेश्वराः॥
en: O masters, I know you always seek the good of the worlds. Therefore, instruct me as to what may be good to myself or to the worlds.

sa: इमे हि सर्वे स्नेहान्मामनुयाता यशस्विनः। भक्ता हि भजितव्याश्च त्यक्तात्मानश्च मत्कृते॥
en: These illustrious ones have followed me out of love. They are worthy of my respect for they are my devotees and have renounced their persons for me.

sa: वैशम्पायन उवाच तं व्यतीतमतिक्रम्य राजा स्वमिव बान्धवम्। सभार्यः शोकदुःखार्तः पर्यदेवयदातुरः॥
en: Vaishampayana said : After the death of the deer, the king (Pandu) like a friend (of his) wept bitterly with his wives, being much afflicted with grief.

sa: वीरो द्रोणविनाशाय धनुरादाय वीर्यवान्। तत्रैव वेद्यां कृष्णापि जज्ञे तेजस्विनी शुभा॥
en: The mighty hero was bom, a bow in his hand, in order to kill Drona hereafter. From the sacrificial altar was born Krishnaa (Draupadi), resplendent and handsome.

sa: दुष्यन्ताद् भरतो जज्ञे विद्वाञ्छाकुन्तलो नृपः। तस्माद् भरतवंशस्य विप्रतस्थे महद् यशः॥
en: Dushyanta begot on his wife, Shakuntala, a learned son, named Bharata who became king. From him was the Bharata dynasty and from his spread its great fame.

sa: एतस्य भुजवीर्येण खाण्डवे हव्यवाहनः। मेदसा सर्वभूतानां तृप्तिं यास्यति वै पराम्॥
en: Agni will be greatly gratified with the fat of all creatures which will be burnt in the Khandava (forest) through the strength of arms of this (hero).

sa: ततः पाण्डुसुताः पञ्च निर्जित्य द्रुपदं युधि। द्रोणाय दर्शयामासुर्बद्ध्वा ससचिवं तदा।॥
en: The Brahmana said : Then the five sons of Pandu defeated Drupada in battle and taking him prisoner along with his ministers, they offered him to Drona.

sa: राज्ञा दत्ता च दाशाय कन्येयं ते भवत्विति। रूपसत्वसमायुक्ता सर्वैः समुदितागुणैः॥
en: Was then given by the king to the fishermen, saying. “Let this (child) be your daughter.” She was gifted with great beauty and possessed of every virtue.

sa: वैशम्पायन उवाच एवमुक्त्वा द्विजश्रेष्ठो देवयानी कचस्तदा। त्रिदशेशालयं शीघ्रं जगाम द्विजसत्तमः॥
en: Vaishampayana said : Having said this to Devayani, that best of Brahmanas, that foremost of the twice-born, Kacha hurriedly went away to the land of the celestials.

sa: ययातिरुवाच ऋतुं वै याचमानाया भगवन् नान्यचेतसा। दुहितुर्दानवेन्द्रस्य धर्म्यमेतत् कृतं मया॥ ऋतुं वै याचमानाया न ददाति पुमानृतुम्। भ्रूणहेत्युच्यते ब्रह्मन् स इह ब्रह्मवादिभिः॥ अभिकामां स्त्रियं यश्च गम्यां रहसि याचितः। नोपैति स च धर्मेषु भ्रूणहेत्युच्यते बुधैः॥
en: Yayati said: Adorable Rishi, I was solicited by the daughter of the Danava king to make her season fruitful. I did grant her prayer from a sense of virtue. O Rishi, men learned in the Vedas say that he, who does not grant the prayer of a woman in season, commits the sin of killing an embryo. He, who, being solicited in secret by a woman full of desire and in season, does not grant her wishes, loses virtue. The learned say that he becomes a killer of embryo.

sa: नारद उवाच युधिष्ठिर सभा दिव्या वरुणस्यामितप्रभा। प्रमाणेन यथा याम्या शुभप्राकारतोरणा॥
en: Narada said O Yudhishthira, the celestials Sabha of Varuna is matchless. Its dimension is exactly like that of Yama. It is adorned with white walls and arches.

sa: कार्यं च सुमहत् पार्थो गाण्डीवेन करिष्यति। चक्रेण वासुदेववश्च तन्ममाद्य प्रदीयताम्॥
en: Partha will (today) accomplish a great deed with the Gandiva (the bow in question) and Vasudeva also with the discus. Therefore, give them both to me today."

sa: न हि योगं प्रपश्यामि येन मुच्येयमापदः। पुत्रदारेण वा सार्धं प्राद्रवेयमनामयम्॥
en: I do not see by what means I can escape from this danger and how can I fiy away (from this place) with my son and wife?

sa: वैशंपायन उवाच हन्त ते कथयिष्यामि नमस्कृत्य स्वयंभुवे। सुरादीनामहं सम्यग्लोकानां प्रभवाप्ययम्॥
en: Vaishampayana said : Bowing down my head to the Self-created (Brahma), I shall narrate to you in detail the origin of the celestials and of all creatures.

sa: निशम्य वचनं भर्तुर्वनवासे धृतात्मनः। तत्समं वचनं कुन्ती माद्री च समभाषताम्॥
en: Having heard these words of their husband who had fixed his mind to retire into a forest, both Kunti and Madri addressed him in these proper words.

sa: इदं चाभरणं सौम्य निर्मितं विश्वकर्मणा। दिव्यं दिव्येन वपुषा दीप्यमानं स्वतेजसा॥
en: This ornament, O gentle one, has been made by the architect of the celestials; its make is very beautiful and it is dazzling by its own lustre.

sa: हयैर्दिव्यैः समायुक्तो रथो वायुसमो जवे। अधिष्ठितः स शुशुभे कृष्णेनातीव भारत॥
en: O descendant of Bharata, that car, with which were yoked celestials horses with the speed of the wind and which was driven by Krishna, looked exceedingly beautiful.

sa: स हि वेदार्थतत्त्वज्ञस्तेषां गुरुरुदारधीः। तेन धर्मविदा पार्था याज्या धर्मविदः कृताः॥
en: The preceptor (Dhaumya) was acquainted with the mystery of the Vedas; he was liberal minded, he made the virtue and all-knowing sons of Pritha his spiritual disciples.

sa: वायुना प्रेर्यमाणस्तु धूम्राय मुदमन्वगात्। तस्य रेतः प्रचस्कन्द चरतो गहने वने॥
en: He breathed the delicious breeze blowing slowly all over the forest. He became so much semen excited. So, the semen of the king discharged in that forest.

sa: गन्धर्व उवाच अथ तस्यामदृश्यायां नृपतिः काममोहितः। पातनः शत्रुसङ्घानां पपात धरणीतले॥
en: The Gandharva said : On the disappearance of the maiden, that chastiser of foes the king, being deprived of his senses by desire, fell on the ground.

sa: पार्थस्तु वरयामास शक्रादस्त्राणि सर्वशः। प्रदातुं तच्च शक्रस्तु कालं चक्रे महाद्युतिः॥
en: Partha asked Indra to bestow upon him all his weapons. Thereupon the greatly effulgent Shakra (Indra) fixed the time to bestow them (on Arjuna). He then said,

sa: सोमस्थानमिदं चेति दर्खास्ते लिलिहुस्तदा। ततो द्विधाकृता जिह्वाः सर्पाणां तेन कर्मणा॥
en: They began to lick with their tongues the Kusha grass in which the Ambrosia had been placed; and by that act, their tongues became divided into two.

sa: अथवापीह दग्धेषु भीष्मोऽस्माकं पितामहः। धर्म इत्येव कुष्येरन् ये चान्ये कुरुपुङ्गवाः॥
en: It may be that if we are brunt, our grandfather Bhishma and other best men of the Kuru race may be indignant for the sake of virtue.

sa: संप्रत्याचक्षते चेदं तथा श्रोष्यन्ति चापरे। पुत्राः शुश्रूषवः सन्ति प्रेष्याश्च प्रियकारिणः॥
en: It is recited in the present age and will be recited in future ages. He, who hears it, gets sons and survivors, who perform their favourite works.

sa: कुरुभ्यः प्रस्थितास्ते तु मध्येन कुरुजाङ्गलम्। रम्यं पद्मसरो गत्वा कालकूटमतीत्य च॥
en: Having started from the Kuru country, they passed through the Kurujangala. They then arrived at the (lake) Padmasara, whence they went to the Kalakuta (mountains). Crossing it,

sa: स्वकर्मनिरताश्चासन्सर्वे वर्णा नराधिप। एवं तदा नरव्याघ्र धर्मो न ह्रसते क्वचित्॥
en: O king, all men of all castes were mindful of the respective duties of their respective castes. O best of men, their virtue never sustained any diminution.

sa: मा द्राक्षीस्त्वं कुलस्यास्य घोरं संक्षयमात्मनः। तथेति समनुज्ञाय सा प्रविश्याब्रवीत् स्नुषाम्॥
en: Do not be able witness of the terrible annihilation of your own race. Saying "Be it so," she entered the inner apartments and addressed her daughters-in-law thus.

sa: पूर्वैः प्रवर्तितं किंचित् कुलेऽस्मिन् नृपसत्तमैः। साधु वा यदि वासाधु तन्नातिक्रान्तमुत्सहे॥
en: But there is a custom in our family ever observed by all the best of our kings. Be it good or bad, I can not transgress it.

sa: सा तं बालमुपादाय मेघलेखेव भास्करम्। कृत्वा च मानुषं रूपमुवाच वसुधाधिपम्॥
en: Then hiding the child in her arms as the clouds envelope the sun, and assuming a human form, she thus spoke to the lord of earth (Brihadratha).

sa: भगवानपि तिग्मांशुः समिद्धः खाण्डवं ततः। ददाह सह कृष्णाभ्यां जनयञ्जगतो हितम्॥
en: Having grown in strength, the illustrious deity of fearful rays also consumed the Khandava with the assistance of the two Krishna's for the good of the world.

sa: एष पर्यायवासो मे वसूनां संनिधौ कृतः। मत्प्रसूतिं विजानीहि गङ्गादत्तमिमं सुतम्॥
en: I promised to the Vasus to live with you so long (as I have lived). Let this child of mine be known by the name of Gangadatta.

sa: न हमीभूतसत्त्वौघाः पन्नगाः सनगां महीम्। तदा धारयितुं शेकुः संक्रान्तां दानवैर्वलात्॥
en: The united strength of the Naga Shesha and other creatures (such as the tortoise and the elephant), could not support the earth, attacked by the powerful Danavas.

sa: युध्यस्वाद्य रणे यत्तः पश्यामः पुरुषो भव। यस्तु शत्रुमभिज्ञाय शुद्धं पौरुषमास्थितः॥
en: Fight with all your might and be a manand we shall see. That ma, who knowing the might of his enemy acts, at the dictates of manliness,

sa: रजस्तमश्चाभिभूय सत्त्वं भवति भारत। रजः सत्त्व तमश्चैव तमः सत्त्वं रजस्तथा।॥
en: Sattva remains if Raja and Tama are repressed. Tame remains if Sattva and Raja are repressed' and, Oh Bharata, Raja remains if Tama and Sattva are repressed.

sa: शिष्यार्थ प्रददौ चाथ द्रोणाय कुरुपुङ्गवा शिखण्डिनं महाराज पुत्रं स्त्रीपूर्विणं तथा॥
en: And then he gave away to Drona as a disciple, O best of the race, his son Shikhandin, who had been before (this) a daughter, O king.

sa: एतत् तत्त्वमहं वेद जन्म तात शिखण्डिनः। ततो नैनं हनिष्यामि समरेष्वाततायिनम्॥
en: I know this truth about the birth of Shikhandin, O son, and therefore I will not slay him in any battle, through with weapon in his hand.

sa: शलभैरिव चाकाशे धाराभिरिव चावृते। अभिमन्योः शरै राजन् न प्राज्ञायत किंचन॥
en: Then when the sky was covered with the arrows of Abhimanyu, like the flights of locusts or thick showers of rain, o king, nothing could be distinguished.

sa: अभियाय च दुर्धर्षां धार्तराष्ट्रस्य वाहिनीम्। प्राङ्मुखाः पश्चिमे भागे न्यविशन्त ससैनिकाः॥
en: Coming near the army of Dhritarashtra's son those invincible heroes encamped with their troops on the Western part (of the field), their faces turned towards the East.

sa: छिन्नां तां शक्तिमालोक्य भीष्मः क्रोधसमन्वितः॥ अचिन्तयद् रणे वीरो बुद्ध्या परपुरंजयः।
en: Beholding his lance severed, Bhishma became inflamed with rage; and that hero that subduer of hostile cities began to think with the help of his understanding thus.

sa: एवं तस्य बलं भीमं कुन्तीपुत्रस्य धीमतः। यदाश्रित्याथ युयुधे धार्तराष्ट्र सुयोधनम्॥
en: Such was the terrible array of forces of that wise son of Kunti, relying on the help of which he fought with Suyodhana, the son of Dhritarashtra.

sa: शीघ्रमनुगमिष्यामो यत्र द्रोणो व्यवस्थितः। कोका इव महानागं मा वै हन्युर्यतव्रतम्॥
en: Let us then swiftly repair to the spot where Drona is stationed. Let not the Pandavas slay Drona, like a pack of wolves slaying a mighty elephant.

sa: ततस्त्रिगर्तराट् क्रुद्धस्तानुवाच महारथान्। अलं द्रुतेन वः शूरा न भयं कर्तुमर्हथ॥
en: Thereupon, excited with rage, the sovereign of the Trigarttas addressing those mighty carwarriors said, 'Fly not, you heroes, it behoves you not to be seized with panic.

sa: तं विसंज्ञं विदित्वा तु त्वरमाणोऽस्य सारथिः। अपोवाह रणाद् राजंस्ततः सैन्यमभज्यत॥
en: O king, seeing him senseless, his charioteer specdily carried him away from the field of battle. Then the the troops that supported Duryodhana broke and fled away.

sa: तत्रासीत् सुमहद् युद्धं तुमुलं लोमहर्षणम्। यथा देवासुरं युद्धं पूर्वमासीत् सुदारुणम्॥
en: Then the batile that was fought was fearful and terrible, like the one that was fought in the days of yore between the celestials and the Danavas.

sa: कर्ण उवाच नैष जातु महाबाहुर्जीवनाहवमुत्सृजेत्। न चेमान् पुरुषव्याघ्र सिंहनादान् सहिष्यति॥
en: Karna said Never will this mighty-armed hero abandon fighting so long life will remain in him; nor will this foremost of men brook the car-cries of others.

sa: रथैरनेकसाहौः क्रोधामर्षसमन्वितः नन्दकस्तव पुत्रस्तु भीमसेनं महाबलम्॥ विव्याध विशिखैः षड्भिः कङ्कपत्रैः शिलाशितैः। दुर्योधनश्च समरे भीमसेनं महारथम्॥ आजघानोरसि क्रुद्धो मार्गणैर्नवभिः शितैः। ततो भीमो महाबाहुः स्वरथं सुमहाबलः॥ आरुरोह रथश्रेष्ठं विशोकं चेदमब्रवीत्। एते महारथाः शूरा धार्तराष्ट्राः समागताः॥
en: Supported by many thousand of cars, and excited with rage and fury, your son Nandaka pierced Bhimasena of great might with keenpointed shafts whetted on stone and winged with the feathers of the Kanka bird. Then also, O monarch, Duryodhana excited with rage, in that fierce fight, struck Bhimasena on the breast with nine whetted shafts. Thereafter the mighty-armed Bhimasena endued with superior strength mounted on his own most excellent chariot and thus addressed his charioteer Vishoka. These heroic and mighty carwarriors, these sons of Dhritarashtra endued with prowess.

sa: स गाढविद्धो व्यथितः स्यन्दनोपस्थ आविशत्। स निषण्णो रथोपस्थे मूर्छामभिजगाम ह॥
en: There-with struck home and afflicted sore, he (Bhima) squatted on the terrace of his car; and when he was thus seated, he was overwhelmed with a swoon.

sa: अद्यैतान् नाशयिष्यामि पश्यतस्ते जनार्दन। य इमे मां यदुश्रेष्ठ योद्धुकामा रणाजिरे॥
en: Today, before your very eyes, I will O Janardana, slay all these, O foremost of the Yadus, who are desirous of fighting with me in the battle".

sa: सिन्धुराजं परित्यज्य सौभद्रः परवीरहा। तापयामास तत् सैन्यं भुवनं भास्करो यथा॥
en: Subhadra's son, the slayer of hostile heroes, having vanquished the king of the Sindhus, consumed the troops led by the latter like the Sun scorching the world.

sa: महाराज मनुष्येषु निन्द्यं यः सर्वमाचरेत्। स वध्यः सर्वलोकस्य निन्दितानि समाचरन्।॥
en: O king of kings, the man who does all sorts of harm to other men deserves to be killed by all men for his these censurable deeds.

sa: यं हि न व्यथयन्त्येते पुरुषं पुरुषर्षभ। समदुःखसुखं धीरं सोऽमृतत्वाय कल्पते।॥
en: The man, who is learned in true knowledge, whom they (contact of senses) afflict not, and to whom pain and pleasure are alike, merits Moksha (final emancipation).

sa: तं तु संधितमाज्ञाय सायकं घोरदर्शनम्। द्वाभ्यां शराभ्यां हार्दिक्यश्चिच्छेद सशरं धनुः॥
en: The son of Hridika seeing that shaft of dreadful sight fixed on the bow-string (of Subinadra's son) cut it down, along with the bow, with two arrows.

sa: ततस्ते मूषिकाः सर्वे समेत्यान्योऽन्यमब्रुवन्। मातुलो वर्धते नित्यं वयं क्षीयामहे भृशम्॥
en: Then did those rats, meeting together, said to one another 'Our maternal uncle is growing up day by day but we are being speedily reduced in numbers.'

sa: यं तु सर्वमनुष्येभ्यः प्राहुः शूरतरं नृपम्। तं पटच्चरहन्तारं शुकवर्णाऽवहन् हयाः॥
en: Steeds of the hue of the blue parrot, bore that king who had slain the Pattacharas and who was regarded as the best hero among all men.

sa: येषामभीषुहस्तः स्याद् विष्वक्सेनो रथे स्थितः॥ संनद्धश्चार्जुनो योद्धा तेषां नास्ति पराजयः।
en: They who have Vishvaksena (Vishnu), clad in armour and reins in hand, on their chariot, they who have Arjuna for their warrior, they can never suffer defeat.

sa: किरनिषुगणांस्तीक्ष्णान् स रश्मीनिव भास्कर.। तापयामास तत् सैन्यं देहं व्याधिगणो यथा॥
en: Then scattering his sharp shafts like the lustrous orb of the day scattering his rays, he afflicted that host of the Kurus like maladies afflicting the body.

sa: धृष्टकेतुः कृपेणास्तान् छित्त्वा बहुविधाञ्छरान्। कृपं विव्याध सप्तत्या लक्ष्म चास्याहरत् त्रिभिः॥
en: Dhristaketu having sundered in twain various shafts shot by Kripa, pierced the latter with seventy arrows; and then with three more cut-off the device on Kripa's standard.
