sa: त्वयि चाहं पराश्वस्तः प्रद्युम्ने वा महारथे। शक्नुयां सैन्धवं हन्तुमनपेक्षो नरर्षभ॥
en: Placing the burden of the king's protection you the mighty car-warrior Pradyumna. I can, O foremost of men, without anxiety, exert myself in slaying the Sindhu king.

sa: पुरस्तादवर्तन्त केऽरक्षन् दक्षिणं चक्र भीष्मस्यामिततेजसः। पृष्ठतः के परान् वीरानपासेधन् यतव्रताः॥
en: Who were they that protected the right of that immeasurably powerful warrior? Who were they that resisted the enemy's warriors from his rear with patience and energy?

sa: हनिष्यति चमूं तेषां महेन्द्रो दानवानिव। मद्रराजो महेष्वासः शल्यो मेऽतिरथो मतः॥
en: He will slay this army like the great Indra slaying the Danavas. In my opinion, the great bowman Shalya, the king of the Madras, is an Atiratha,

sa: ततः शब्देन महता विननाद महास्वनः। तेन नादेन वित्रस्ता कलिङ्गानां वरूथिनी॥
en: Possessing as he does a fearfully loud voice, he also sent up a very loud shout. At his fearful shouts, the Kalingas were filled with great alarm.

sa: रजो दृष्ट्वा समुद्भूतं श्रुत्वा च गजनिःस्वनम्। भगदत्ते विकुर्वाणे कौन्तेयः कृष्णमब्रवीत्॥
en: Seeing the cloud of dust and hearing the noise created by the troops when Bhagadatta was achieving feats of valour, the son of Kunti thus addressed Krishna.

sa: तु न हि शक्यो युधिष्ठिरः। ग्रहीतुं समरे राजन् सेन्ट्रैरपि सुरासुरैः॥
en: But, Oking, before the eyes of Phalguna, Yudhishthira cannot be captured in battle, even by the celestials and the Asuras exerting jointly with Indra at their head.

sa: व्याघ्रदत्तश्च राजेन्द्र चन्द्रसेनश्च भारत। मतौ मम रथोदारौ पाण्डवानां न संशयः॥
en: Vyaghradatta, O king among kings, and Chandrasena, O Bharata, are in my opinion two Maharathas on the side of the Pandavas, there is no doubt about it.

sa: ये चैव ते रथोदाराः पाण्डुपुत्रस्य सैनिकाः। सहसैन्यानहं तांश्च प्रतीयां रणमूर्धनि॥
en: I shall advance also against these who are mighty car-warriors in the army of the son of Pandu along with their armies at the time of battle.

sa: ते निवृत्ताश्च भग्नाश्च दृष्ट्वा तल्लाघवं मम। अथाहं हास्तिनपुरमायां जित्वा महीक्षितः॥
en: Seeing that lightness of hand on my part, they broke up and turned back and vanquishing those kings I came to the city called after the elephant.

sa: तदन्तरं च सम्प्रेक्ष्य त्वरमाणो महारथः। प्रसंदधे शितं बाणं गिरीणामपि दारणम्॥
en: At this opportunity, that mighty car-warrior Duryodhana without the least delay placed on his bow string another sharp arrow capable of penetrating even through the very mountains.

sa: साधु साध्वति ते सर्वे पूजयांचक्रिरे तदा। चक्रुश्चैव यथान्यायं डिण्डिकस्य वचोऽर्थवत्॥
en: These words were applauded by them with the exclamation "well said" "well said" and they acted according to the suggestion of Dindika, which was consistent with reason.

sa: संशयं परमं प्राप्तं मज्जन्तं व्यसनार्णवे। एते क्रुद्धा महेष्वासाः पाण्डवानां महारथाः॥
en: Who is now involved in a great predicament and is being sunk into the sea of danger. These irate car-warriors of the Pandava army, these fierce bow-men,

sa: माद्रीपुत्रौ च सहितौ द्रौपदेयाश्च दंशिताः॥ ये चान्ये पृथिवीपालाः प्रधानाः पुरुषर्षभ।
en: The sons of Madri, the sons of Draupadi clad in armour and also all the other foremost of kings, O best of men, (will also follow you)"

sa: नारी विदितविज्ञानः परेषां धर्ममादिशन्। यथेष्टं गम्यतां भद्रे मा त्वां कालोऽत्यगादयम्॥
en: A king, who is familiar with every science and who lays down laws for others. Go wherever you please, gentle lady, and do not waste your time.”

sa: एवं तव बलं सर्वं हैडिम्बेन दुरात्मना। सूर्यास्तमनवेलायां प्रभग्नं विद्रुतं दिशः॥
en: Thus it was that your whole army was broken and routed in all directions by the wicked-souled son of Hidimba at the time when the sun set.

sa: द्रोणं द्रोणमिति क्रूराः पञ्चाला: समचोदयन्। मा द्रोणमिति पुत्रास्ते कुरून् सर्वानचोदयन्॥
en: The fierce Panchalas urged on their troops saying, “There is Drona, there is Drona," whilst your sons urged on the Kurus, saying, 'Let not Drona be slain'.

sa: तपस्तप्त्वा तु याँल्लोकान् प्राप्नुवन्ति तपस्विनः। क्षत्रधर्माश्रिता वीराः क्षत्रियाः प्राप्नुवन्ति तान्॥
en: Those regions to which the ascetics repair through their observance of ascetic austerities, even those regions the heroic Kshatriyas attain, by the observance of their own duties.”

sa: अर्जुनेन यमाभ्यां वा भीमसेनेन वा पुनः। राजधर्मं पुरस्कृत्य राजा राजानमार्छति॥
en: Or with Arjuna or with Bhimasena or with the twins Nakula and Sahadeva. Keeping in view the duty of a king, a king strikes another royal compose.

sa: तान् दृष्ट्वाभ्युद्यतान् संख्ये पाण्डवा हि यशस्विनः। श्येनेन व्यूहराजेन तेनाजव्येन संयुगे॥
en: The sons of Pandu endued with fame, seeing the Kauravas ready for the encounter, formed their troops in that invincible and excellent array that figures a hawk.

sa: अङ्कुशाङ्गुनुदितः स गजप्रवरो युधि। तस्मिन् क्षणे समभवत् सांवर्तक इवानलः ॥
en: That foremost of elephants, thus urged on by the press and stroke of the toe and the hook, in that battle destructive like the fire of dissolution.

sa: अभिमन्योः पितुर्भीतः सव्रीडो वाक्यमब्रवीत्। योऽसौ पाण्डो:किल क्षेत्रे जातः शक्रेण कामिना॥
en: And afraid of the father of Abhimanyu and overwhelmed with shame, he spoke these words-"He, who was begotten upon the wife of Pandu by the lustful Indra.

sa: ततः सैन्धवको राजा क्षुद्रस्तात जयद्रथः। वरदानेन रुद्रस्य सर्वान् नः समवारयत्॥
en: Then alas, O sire, the puny ruler of the Sindhus, king Jayadratha resisted us all, through the virtue of a boon received from the god Rudra (Mahadeva).

sa: प्रविश्य त रणे भीमो मकरं मुखतस्तदा। भीष्ममासाद्य संग्रामे च्छादयामास सायकैः॥
en: Then in the battle that commenced Bhima, penetrating through the mouth of the Makara like array of the Kauravas, approached Bhishma and covered him over with arrows.

sa: स तामपृच्छत् कात्स्येन व्यसनोत्पत्तिमादितः। सा च तस्मै यथावृत्तं विस्तरेण न्यवेदयत्॥
en: He asked her the story of her wrongs from its origin and in detail and she too submitted to him everything as it had happened in detail.

sa: हा पुत्रकावितृप्तस्य सततं पुत्रदर्शने॥ भाग्यहीनस्य कालेन यथा मे नीयसे बलात्।
en: Oh! my dear child, I, who was never satiated with looking at you. Alas! unfortunate that I am I have been forcibly bereft of you by Death.

sa: भित्त्वानीकं महेष्वासः परेषां बहुशो युधि। कच्चिन्न निहतः संख्ये सौभद्रः परवीरहा॥
en: Has that fierce bowman, that slayer of hostile heroes, namely, the son of Subhadra, having penetrated into those numberless divisions of the enemy, been slain in battle.

sa: अवतद् दीप्यमाना च सनिर्घाता सकम्पना॥ उल्का ज्वलन्ती संग्रामे पुच्छेनावृत्य सर्वशः।
en: On the field of battle, illuminating the welkin, dropped many a burning meteor accompanied with thundering sounds and vibrating motions and covering with their tails large areas.

sa: हरिर्वसति वैकुण्ठः शकटे कनकामये॥ अष्टचक्रं हि तद् यान् भूतयुक्तं मनोजवम्।
en: The eternal Hari lives on His golden chariot. That chariot is furnished with eight wheels. Innumerable supernatural creatures are placed there each having the fleetness of mind.

sa: नात्यश्नतस्तु योगोऽस्ति न चैकान्तमनश्नतः। न चाति स्वप्नशीलस्य जाग्रतो नैव चार्जुन॥
en: Devotion is not achieved by the man. O Arjuna, who eats too much, or eats nothing, who is addicted to too much sleep, or is always awake.

sa: समुत्सृज्याथ शैनेयो गौतमं रथिनां वरः। द्रौणि राहुः खे शशिनं यथा॥
en: Thereupon that foremost of car-warriors the grandson of Shini, forsaking Gautama's son in battle, rushed towards Drona's son, like Rahu in the firmament rushing towards the moon.

sa: मनुष्याणां सहस्रेषु कश्चिद् यतति सिद्धये। यतततामपि सिद्धानां कश्चिन्मां वेत्ति तत्त्वतः॥
en: One only among thousands of men tries to get perfection; and even among those that are assiduous and have achieved perfection, only very few know Me truly.

sa: भूमौ सर्वे तदा राजन् भस्मभूताः प्रपेदिरे। तदा शतसहस्राणि प्रयुतान्यर्बुदानि च॥
en: At the time, O king, every body on earth, was reduced to ashes. At that time, hundreds and thousands, and tens of thousands and hundreds of thousands,

sa: अब्राह्मणानां यद वित्तं पृथिव्यामस्ति किंचन। तत् सर्वे परिसंख्याय ततो ब्राह्मणसात्करोत्॥
en: He gave unto the Brahmanas all the wealth on the face of Earth, belonging to the nonBrahmana sect, having at first taken an account of them all.

sa: संजय उवाच तस्य लालप्यतः श्रुत्वा कुरुवृद्धः पितामहः। देशकालोचितं वाक्यमब्रवीत् प्रीतमानसः॥
en: Sanjaya said When he had been thus speaking, the venerable grandsire of the Kurus, pleased with him, addressed to him these words suitable to season and place.

sa: अभ्यवर्तन्त भीष्मस्य रथं हेमपरिष्कृतम्॥ जिघांसन्तं युधां श्रेष्ठं तदाऽऽसीत् तुमुलं महत्।
en: Those great car-warriors rushed towards Bhishma's car decked with gold, with the intention of killing that foremost of warriors. The battle that was then fought was fearful.

sa: ततो रविर्मन्दमरीचिमण्डलो जगामास्तं पांसुपुञ्जावगूढः। निशा व्यगाहत् सुखशीतमारुता ततो युद्धं प्रत्यवहारयावः॥
en: Then did the sun, covered by dust and its effulgence clouded, slowly set and night came on with its cool breezes and then we desisted from war.

sa: विराटनगरे तात संजयस्य समीपतः। भीष्मद्रोणमुखान् सर्वान् धार्तराष्ट्रस्य सैनिकान्॥ सानुबन्धान् हनिष्यामि ये मां योत्स्यन्ति संगरे। इति तत् कुरु कौन्तेय सत्यं वाक्यमरिंदम॥
en: In the city of Virata, before Sanjaya himself. O Pritha's son, those words are 'I will slay all the combatants of Dhritarashtra's son along with their followers, headed by Bhishma and Drona, all who will fight with me.' O son of Kunti, O grinder of foes, do you now verify those words of yours.

sa: तत एवमुवाचार्तः क्रोधपर्याकुलेक्षणम्॥ निःश्वसन्तं यथा नागमर्जुनः प्रणयात् सखा। निवर्तस्व महाबाहो नानृतं कर्तुमर्हसि॥ यत् त्वया कथितं पूर्वं न योत्स्यामिति केशव। मिथ्यावादीति लोकास्त्वां कथयिष्यन्ति माधव॥
en: Then his friend Arjuna, highly distressed, affectionately addressing Keshava, who was then breathing like a snake and whose eyes were rolling in wrath, said 'Stop, O mightyarmed one! It behooves you not to falsify those words of yours viz., 'I will not fight,' that you had spoken before, O Keshava. Then, O descendant of Madhu's race, men will call your a liar.

sa: ततो युधिष्ठिरो राजा मन्त्रयित्वा चिरं नृप। वासुदेवं समुद्वीक्ष्य वचनं चेदमाददे॥
en: Thereafter king Yudhishthira, O king, having pondered for a considerable length of time, addressed these words to the son of Vasudeva, casting his eyes on the latter.

sa: तस्याश्वांश्चतुरो हत्वा सारथिं च महाबलः। अभ्यद्रवत सौभद्रो लक्ष्मणं निशितैः शरैः॥
en: Thereat that mighty car-warrior the son of the Subhadra, slaying the four steeds of Lakshmana, as also his charioteer, rushed at him covering him with sharp shafts.

sa: नारद उवाच सुहोत्रं नाम राजानं मृतं सृञ्जय शुश्रुम। एकवीरमशक्यं तममरैरभिवीक्षितुम्॥
en: Narada said O Srinjaya, we heard also of the death of king Suhotra, who was the foremost of all heroes, invincible and interviewed by the gods themselves.

sa: किं पुनर्ब्राह्मणाः पुण्या भक्ता राजर्षयस्तथा। अनित्यमसुखं लोकमिमं प्राप्य भजस्व माम्॥
en: What then should I speak of holy Brahmins and royal sages who are my devotees? Having come to this miserable and mortal world, O Partha, worship Me.

sa: आत्मानं वै प्राणिनो मन्ति सर्वे नैतान् मृत्युदण्डपाणिर्हिनस्ति। तस्मान्मृतान् नानुशोचन्ति धीरा मृत्युं ज्ञात्वा निश्चयं ब्रह्मसृष्टम्। इत्थं सृष्टि देवक्लप्तां विदित्वा पुत्रान्नष्टाच्छोकमाशु त्यजस्व॥
en: Creatures destroy themselves. Death does not destroy any one, armed though she is with the mortal dart. Therefore the wise, knowing death to be unavoidable being ordained by Brahma, never lament for those that are dead. Now knowing that death is ordained by the highest divinity, renounce, without delay, your sorrow for you son.

sa: एवं द्वादश वर्षाणि तापयामास रोदसी। निवर्त्यमानापि च सा ज्ञातिभि:व शक्यते॥
en: And thus she continued for twelve years (her austerities) and made the heaven not. Nor could she be made to desist from the course by her relatives.

sa: स तेना तभृशं विद्धः प्रेक्ष्य भीष्मः शिखाण्डनम्। अनिच्छन्निव संक्रुद्धः प्रहसन्निदमब्रवीत्॥
en: Bhishma-who then resembled an enraged snake of virulent venom or the Destroyer himself let loose by time. Thus sorely pierced by Shikhandin Bhishma loO king at him.

sa: यथा पशुगणान् पाल: संकलयति कानने। तथेदं मामकं सैन्यं काल्यते शत्रुतापन॥
en: Just as a herd-man be labours his herd in the forest (with a cudgel), so, afflicter of foes, see my army belahored by Arjuna (with his arrows).

sa: विहाय राक्षसं युद्धे शैनेयो रथिनां वरः। प्राग्ज्योतिषाय चिक्षेप शरान् संनतपर्वणः॥
en: Then leaving alone the Rakshasa in battle, that foremost of car-warriors namely the grandson of Shini, hurled dares of depressed knots against the ruler of the Pragjyotishas.

sa: इत्येवं स महातेजा दुःखितेभ्यो महाद्युतिः। धर्मराजो युधां श्रेष्ठो ब्रुवन् दुःखमपानुदत्॥
en: Possessed of great energy and great effulgence, the virtuous king Yudhishthira thar best of all warriors, himself overwhelmed with grief, tried to console them with those words.

sa: दृष्ट्वा पतितं भूमौ चन्द्रार्कसदृशद्युतिम्। तावकानां परा प्रीतिः पाण्डूनां चाभवद् यथा॥
en: Beholding Abhimanyu equal to the sun or the moon in splendour lie dead on the field, your troops obtained great joy whilst the Pandavas were highly distressed.

sa: रथं रथेन समरे पीडयित्वा महाबलौ॥ तावन्योन्यं हि समरे निहत्य रथवाजिनः।
en: Those two heroes both endued with great prowess, then made their cars collide against one another; and in that conflict slaying the steeds of one another's chariot.

sa: तस्याद्य विप्रलम्भस्य फलं प्राप्नुहि दुर्मते। एष त्वा सजनामात्यमुद्धरामि स्थिरो भव॥
en: Take now the fruit of that act of deception, O wicked one, for I will now slay you with all your relatives and ministers. Wait a bit.”

sa: तं चेह निकृतिप्रज्ञं पाञ्चाल्यं पापचेतसम्। पुरस्कृत्य रणे पार्थो भीष्मस्यायोधनं गतः॥
en: Placing before him that prince of the Panchalas, who is of sinful and who is ever inclined to deceitful behaviour, Partha is proceeding for battle towards Bhishma.

sa: सृजते च पुनर्लोकान् नेह विद्यति शाश्वतम्। ज्ञातीनां वै कुरूणां च सम्बन्धिसुहृदां तथा॥ धयं देशय पन्थानं समर्थो ह्यसि वारणे। क्षुद्रं जातिवधं प्राहुर्मा कुरुष्व ममाप्रियम्॥
en: It is Time also which creates the worlds. There is nothing here on earth which is everlasting. Therefore show the path of virtue। to the Kurus, to your relations, your kinsmen and friends. You are the proper person to restrain them. It is said that slaughter of kinsmen is sinful. Do not act in a way which would be disagreeable to me.

sa: यक्षेणमिता राजन् स्थूणाकर्णेन पालितम्। तद्भयादेव च जनो विसर्जयति तद् वनम्॥
en: That forest, O king, was inhabited by a very rich and powerful Yaksha named Sthunakarna a and it was through his fear that men forsook that forest.

sa: वैशम्पायन उवाच एवमुक्तो मुनिस्तत्त्वं कवीन्द्रो राजसत्तम। धृतराष्ट्रेण पुत्रेण ध्यानमन्वगमत् परम्॥
en: Vaishampayana said O foremost of kings, having been thus addressed by his son Dhritarashtra, that best of poets, that Rishi Vyasa, concentrated his mind in great meditation.

sa: शिखण्डिन्युवाच प्रतिदास्यामि भगवन् पुंल्लिङ्गं तव सुव्रत। किञ्चित्कालान्तरं स्त्रीत्वं धारयस्व निशाचर॥
en: Shikhandin said O you of good vows, I will return to you your manhood, O God. Only for a certain period bear by womanhood, O night ranger.

sa: अभीषूश्च हयांश्चैव तथोभौ पार्ष्णसारथी। एतत् कुरु महेष्वास राधेय यदि शक्यते॥
en: The reins of his steeds and his two supporters of the flanks. O mighty bow-man, 0 son of Radha, if you are competent, then do all these.

sa: यदाह मां भवान् ब्रह्मन् सम्बन्धिवचनाद् वचः। अस्योत्तरंप्रतिवचो दूतो राज्ञे वदिष्यति॥
en: What you have spoken, O Brahmana, according to the words of my kinsman (son's father-in-law) receive its reply, my messenger will give the answer to the king.

sa: तांस्तु सर्वान् महेष्वान् सर्वविद्यासु निष्ठितान्। व्यष्टम्भयद् रणे बापौः सौभद्रः परवीरहा॥
en: Then that slayer of hostile heroes, namely Subhadra's son, assailed by means of his arrows, all those mighty car-warriors all well accomplished in all kinds of learning.

sa: तत्राद्भुतमपश्याम रणे पार्थस्य विक्रमम्। शरैः संवार्य तान् वीरान् यज्जघान महाबलः॥
en: In that battle we bcheld the marvelous prowess of the mighty Arjuna, in as much as, checking those heroes by his shafts, he slew troops by hundreds.

sa: पादयोस्तु महाराज स्थितः श्रीमान् महारथः। कुन्तिभोजः शतानीको महत्या सेनया वृतः॥
en: O mighty monarch, at the feet of that array were stationed the ever prosperous and mighty car-warrior namely the Kuntibhoja, and Shatanika supported by a large division.

sa: अभ्यधावन् सुसंक्रुद्धाः सौभद्रमपराजितम्। ते तु पौत्रेण ते राजन प्रायशो विमुखीक़ताः॥
en: All these warriors excited with rage rushed against the invincible son of Subhadra. Then those warriors also, O king, were almost beat back by your grandson (Abhimanyu).

sa: एतच्छ्रुत्वा महाराज गौतमस्य विशाम्पते। अनुमान्य कृपं राजा प्रययौ येन मद्रराट्॥
en: O king, having heard these words of Gautama (Kripa) and after having paid him due respect, the king went to the place where the Madra king was.

sa: अप्रधृष्यमनावार्यं सर्वशस्त्रभृतां वरम्। द्रौणिं प्रति ययौ यत्तः पाञ्चाल्यः सह सोदरैः॥
en: The prince of the Panchalas wrought up with rage and supported by his uterine brothers rushed against Drona's invincible, irresistible, and foremost of all wielders of weapons.

sa: सुप्तं चैनं यमः साक्षादुपागच्छत् सकिङ्करः। स एनमनयद् बद्ध्वा दिशं पितृनिषेविताम्॥
en: When he fell asleep Yama in person together with his attendants approached him and tying him (with the noose) proceeded towards the region inhabited by the Pitris.

sa: ब्रह्मोवाच यस्माद् राक्षसयोनौ ते जातस्यामित्रकर्शन्। नाधर्मे धीयते बुद्धिरमरत्वं ददानि ते॥
en: Brahma said : O repressor of your enemies, as your mind is not inclined to impiety, although you are born as a Rakshasas, I grant you immortality.

sa: तस्माद् रणे द्वैरथे मां प्रत्युद्यातारमच्युत। वृतवान् परमं कृष्णं प्रतीपं सव्यसाचिनः॥
en: Therefore have I, O Achyuta, in a single fight between two car warriors in the ensuing battle, been selected as the best opened and match of Savyasachi.

sa: वैशम्पायन उवाच स्त्रीमध्य उक्तस्तेनासौ तद् वाक्यमभयंकरम्। अन्त:पुरे श्लाघमान इदं वचनमब्रवीत्॥
en: Vaishampayana said Being thus addressed by him in the midst of females with fearless words in the inner apartment he gave went to the following praiseworthy words.

sa: असंशयं क्लेशितास्ते वने चेह च पाण्डवाः। प्राप्ताश्च धर्मतः सर्वं पितुर्धनमसंशयम्॥
en: Kiritin the son of Pritha is strong, well coached in handling weapons and of mighty prowess; who is there to stand against Dhananjaya the son of Pandu?

sa: तस्मात् प्रायमुपासिष्ये हि शक्ष्यामि जीवितुम्। चेतयानो हि को जीवेत् कृच्छ्राच्छत्रुभिरुद्धतः॥
en: I shall therefore die of starvation; I shall not be able to live. Rescued by one's own enemy, what man of manliness could dragon (a miserable) existence?

sa: हितं हि धर्तराष्ट्राणां पाण्डवानां तथैव च। पृथिव्यां क्षत्रियाणां च यतिष्येऽहममायया॥
en: With all sincerity shall I strive for the good of the sons of Dhritarashtra and of the Pandavas and indeed of the Kshatriya race of the world.

sa: सेयं तव करप्राप्ता हत्वैकं रिपुमूर्जितम्। गर्जन्तं प्रतपन्तं च मामेवैष्यति सूतज॥
en: But, O charioteer's son, hurled by your hand, it shall kill one powerful enemy (of yours), roaring and hot as fire and shall then return to me.

sa: अलभ्यः पुनस्श्वैस्तु रथात् सोऽतिप्रपादयेत्॥ ते शरा द्विट्शरीरेषु यथैव न ससज्जिरे।
en: And no sooner they saw him he felled them from the chariot with their horses. As his arrows were not impeded by the bodies of his enemies.

sa: अनुव्रजन्ती भर्तारं जगाम मृदुगामिनी। द्विधेष हृदयं कृत्वा तं च कालमवेक्षती॥
en: With her heart divided into two parts, she (with one of these) replying to her husband and (with the other) awaiting the (fatal) hour, followed him slowly.

sa: अर्जुनोऽहं महाराज व्यक्तं ते श्रोत्रमागतः। भीमादवरजः पार्थो यमाभ्यां चापि पूर्वजः॥
en: I am Arjuna, Oking. You might have heard that I am the son of Pritha, the younger brother of Bhima and the elder brother of the twins.

sa: जानाति हि यथा भीष्मः पाण्डवानां यशस्विनाम्। बलवत्तां सपुत्राणां धर्मज्ञानां महात्मनाम्॥
en: Bhishma knows the truth of the sons of Pandu and their sons of great fame and prowess, conversant with the code of morality and having large minds.

sa: चिन्तयित्वा मुहूर्तं तु तारा ताराधिप्रभा। पतिमित्यब्रवीत् प्राज्ञा शृणु सर्वं कपीश्वर।॥
en: The wise Tara, resplendent as the lord of the stars, reflecting a moment thus replied to her husband. “O lord of the monkeys, listen to all this.

sa: विश्रान्तोऽसि महाभाग विनिद्रश्च नृपात्मज! यदि शक्यं समुत्तिष्ठ विगाढां पश्य शर्वरीम्॥
en: O blessed one, you are (now) soothed and O prince, you have awakened from sleep. If you are able, rise up. Look, the night is far advanced.

sa: किमर्थमसि सम्प्राप्ता विज्ञातश्च कथं त्वहम्। ततः सा कथयामास नहुषस्य विचेष्टितम्॥
en: With what object have you come here and by what means came you to know that I was here. Then did she narrate the attempt of Nahusha.

sa: धृतराष्ट्रश्च पाण्डुश्च सुतावेकस्य विश्रुतौ। तयोः समानं द्रविणं पैतृकं नात्र संशयः॥
en: It is known that Dhritarashtra and Pandu are the sons of one and their paternal kingdom must be shared by them equally-there is no doubt about it.

sa: किमसौ चेष्टते सूत योत्स्यमानो युधिष्ठिरः। के वास्य भ्रातृपुत्राणां पश्यन्त्याज्ञेप्सवो मुखम्॥
en: What preparations are Yudhishthira, who is ready for war, making? Who among his sons and brothers are looking up to his face desirous of receiving his orders?

sa: जगाम राजन् दुःखार्तो गङ्गाद्वाराय भारत। स देवं शरणं गत्वा विरूपाक्षमुमापितम्॥
en: And stricken with sorrow the king, O Bharata, went to the gate of the Ganges. Then sceking the shelter of the deity Virupaksha, the lord of Uma.

sa: तदैव कुरवः सर्वे निराशा जीवितेऽभवन्। भीष्मद्रोणौ यदा राजा न सम्यगनुभाषते॥
en: From that time did all the Kurus despair of their lives, when the king did not give a proper reply to the speeches of Bhishma and Drona.

sa: ब्राह्मण उवाच हिरण्यकण्ठ्यः प्रमदा यच्चान्यत् प्रीतिवर्धनम्। नाहं दत्तमिहेच्छामि तदर्थभ्यः प्रदीयताम्॥
en: The Brahmana said : I do not wish to have beauteous damsels with gold necklaces or other agreeable things. Give these (things) to those that beg them.

sa: उद्यच्छेदेव न नमेदुद्यमो ह्येव पौरुषम्। अप्यपर्वणि भज्येत न नमेतेह कस्यचित्॥
en: He should stand erect and never bend down for energy is manliness. One away break down at his knots (weak points) but he should not bend down.

sa: सर्वकामैः संविभक्तः पूजितश्च यथासुखम्। अहं वै धार्तराष्ट्राणां कुर्यां तदफलं कथम्॥
en: All my my desires were granted and worshipped by them; I was happy and comfortable; how can I make that worship of the sons of Dhritarashtra vain?

sa: एकमेवाद्वितीयं तद् यद् राजन् नावबुध्यसे। सत्यं स्वर्गस्य सोपानं पारावारस्य नौरिव॥
en: The Being, who has no rival, whom you have not been able to comprehend, is Truth and the Way to Heaven, like a boat in the ocean.

sa: दृष्ट्वा विराटनगरे भ्रातरं निहतं प्रियम्। धनंजयेन विक्रम्य किमनेन तदा कृतम्॥
en: Having seen in the city of Virata his dear brother killed by Dhananjaya who evinced a great deal of prowess, what did he do at that time.

sa: शप्तो ह्येष पुरा पापो वधू रम्भां परामृशन्। न शक्नोत्यवशां नारीमुपैतुमजितेन्द्रियः॥
en: Formerly this sinful wretch was cursed for having committed rape on his (own) daughterin-law, Rambha. (Therefore) this lustful being is not capable of forcibly violating any woman.

sa: महद् वो भयमागामि न चेच्छाम्यथ पाण्डवैः। गदया भीमसेनेन हताः शममुपैष्यथ॥
en: A heavy calamity will you meet, if you do not conclude peace with the Pandavas. Killed by Bhimasena with his mace, will you ever remain in peace.

sa: गोसहस्राणि रत्नानि वस्त्राणि विविधानि च। भूषणानि च मुख्यानि यानानि शयनानि च॥ भोजनानि च हृद्यानि पानानि विविधानि च। तन्महोत्सवसंकाशं हृष्टपुष्टजनायुतम्। नगरं मत्स्यराजस्य शुशुभे भरतर्षभ।॥
en: He offered several thousand cows, gems, various type of garments, ornaments, cardinal vehicles, bed, eatables and several type of drinks also. O Janamejaya! The city of Matsyaraja crowded with thousands of lakhs hale and hearty people was being seen as a great festivity in live feature. Thus ends the seventy-second chapter, the marriage of Abhimanyu in the Vaivahika of the Virata Parva.

sa: त ऊचुर्माधवं वीरं कुरवो मधुसूदनम्। निवेदयामो वार्ष्णेय सरत्नांस्ते गृहान् वयम्॥
en: Those Kurus said to the heroic Madhava, the slayer of Madhu, 'You scion of the Vrishni race, we place at your disposal our abodes ornamented with gems.'

sa: विराटश्च शिखण्डी च शैशुपालिश्च दंशिताः। यावन्न प्रविशन्त्येते नक्रा इव महार्णवम्॥
en: And Virata and Sikhandi and the son of Shishupala clad in their coats of mail, do not penetrate into your army like crocodiles in the great sea,

sa: एषं भ्रान्ते रथे तिष्ठन् भल्लेनापाहरच्छिरः। जम्भस्य ग्रसमानस्य तदा ह्यर्जुन आहवे॥
en: Seated on a revolving car, this Arjuna, by mcans of a broad-headed arrow, cut down the head of Jambha, who had opened his mouth to swallow him.

sa: निद्रातन्द्रे क्रोधहर्षों क्षुत्पिपासे हिमातपौ। एतानि पार्था निर्जित्य नित्यं वीरसुखे रताः॥
en: Sleep, laziness, anger, joy hunger and thirst, the Partha's having brought all these under control are ever attached to the enjoyment of happiness attainable by heroes only.

sa: वैशम्पायन उवाच संजयस्य वचः श्रुत्वा प्रज्ञाचक्षुर्जनेश्वरः। ततः संख्यातुमारेभे तद्वचो गुणदोषतः॥
en: Vaishampayana said Hearing the words of Sanjaya, then that lord of men having eyes of wisdom then commenced to count the merits and defects of that speech.

sa: दुर्योधनेयं चिन्ता मे शश्वन्न व्युपशाम्यति। सत्यं ह्येतदहं मन्ये प्रत्यक्षं नानुमानतः॥
en: O Duryodhana, this thought never leaves my mind; it is very true that I see with my own eyes and do not infer it from my imagination.

sa: अमृतादुत्थितं दिव्यं तनुवर्म सकुण्डलम्। धारयामास तं गर्भं दैवं च विधिनिर्मितम्॥
en: And that child was kept alive on account of the celestials mail and ear-rings both made of Amrita and also on account of the ordinance of Destiny.

sa: इन्द्राणी सम्प्रहृष्टात्मा सम्पूज्यनामथाब्रवीत्। इच्छामि त्वामहं ज्ञातुं का त्वं ब्रूहि वरानने॥
en: The Queen of Indra became well-pleased and having propitiated her, thus spoke-O you of a beautiful face, 'I want to know you, tell me who you are.'

sa: यदि तावच्छमं कुर्यान्यायेन कुरुपुङ्गवः। न भवेत् कुरुपाण्डूनां सौभ्रात्रेण महान् क्षयः॥
en: If the chief among the Kurus seek peace on equal terms, there will be no injury done to the brotherly feeling between the Kauravas and the Pandavas.

sa: वदान्यः सत्यसंधश्च सर्वभूतहिते रतः। वर्तमानः पितुः शास्त्रे ब्राह्मणानां तथैव च॥
en: He was benevolent, attached to truth and devoted to the good of all creatures and ever obeyed the command of his father as also of the Brahmanas.

sa: पाण्डुस्तु राज्यं सम्प्राप्तः कनीयानपि सन् नृपः। विनाशे तस्य पुत्राणामिदं राज्यमरिंदम।॥
en: That ruler of men Pandu too obtained the kingdom though he was younger and at his death this kingdom, O chastiser of foes, belongs to his sons.

sa: यदेवानन्तरं कार्य तद् भवान् कर्तुमर्हति। तारणायास्य दुःखस्य प्रस्थानाय जयाय च॥
en: Now it behoves you to do all that is necessary for our departure, for the removal of our woes and for the achievement of victory over foe.

sa: यच्चैव नगरे तस्मिञ्छूयते महदद्भुतम्। एकस्य च बहूनां च पर्याप्तं तन्निदर्शनम्॥
en: This tall story that we hear of what occurred in that city-the struggle between one and many is sufficient proof (of what I say regarding their superiority).

sa: वैशम्पायन उवाच दुर्योधने धार्तराष्ट्रे तद् वचो नाभिनन्दति। तूष्णीम्भूतेषु सर्वेषु समुत्तस्थुर्नरर्षभाः॥
en: Vaishampayana said On Duryodhana; the son of Dhritarashtra, not minding this speech much and all the others remaining damp those bulls among men rose up (and departed).

sa: यत् त्वस्य प्रियमातिथ्यं मानार्हस्य महात्मनः। तदस्मै क्रियतां राजन् मानार्होऽसौ जनार्दनः॥
en: Show him however, that hospitality which is acceptable to that large-souled one deserving of honour. O king, that Janardana is the proper party for showing honour to.

sa: एकतो वा जगत् कृत्स्नमेकतो वा जनार्दनः। सारतो जगतः कृत्स्नादतिरिक्तो जनार्दनः॥
en: If the entire world be placed on one side and Janardana on the other; then will the entire world be surpassed by Janardana in point of strength.

sa: सर्वे ह्येते श्रिया युक्ताः सर्वे श्रीवत्सलक्षणाः। सर्वे श्रियमभीप्सन्तो धारयन्ति बलान्युत॥
en: All these are endued with prosperity; and all have the mark of Srivatsa (an auspicious mark); and all of them, desirous of prosperity, are endued with strength.

sa: यस्य संग्राममध्ये तु दिव्यमस्त्रं प्रकुर्वतः। रूपं द्रक्ष्यन्ति पुरुषा रामस्येव महात्मनः॥
en: Whose form in the midst of the fight, while displaying celestial weapons, people will see to be like that of the great-souled Rama (should be the commander).

sa: दिष्ट्या पश्यामि राजेन्द्र धर्मात्मानं सहानुगम्। निस्तीर्णं दुष्करं राजंस्त्वा धर्मनिचयं प्रभो॥
en: It is fortunate that I see, O king O chief among the kings, O Lord, yourself, the treasury of virtues and large-minded, come out of your difficulties.

sa: द्वैरथे समरे नान्यो भीष्मं हन्यान्महाव्रतम्। शिखण्डिनमृते वीरं स मे सेनापतिर्मतः॥
en: In hand single combat, no one save Shikhandin could slay that hero, Bhishma, of great vows and it is my opinion that he should be our general.

sa: नारद उवाच अथ प्रचलितः स्थानादासनाच्च परिच्युतः। कम्पितेनेव मनसा धर्षितः शोकवह्निना॥
en: Narada said Being thus turned out from his place in heaven) and deprived of his seat there, his heart trembling and consumed by the fire of grief.

sa: दिष्ट्या समग्रान् पश्यामि भ्रातूंस्ते कुरुनन्दन। विजिगीषन् रणे युक्तान् निर्जितारीन् महारथान्॥
en: O descendant of Kuru, by good luck alone that I am enabled to see your brothers, who are all mighty car-warriors, come off victorious from that battle.

sa: ततः प्रगृह्य विपुलां शतघण्टां विभीषणः। अनुमन्त्र्य महाशक्तिं चिक्षेपास्य शिरः प्रति॥
en: Then Vibhishana, taking up a huge and mighty Javelin studded with a hundred bells and inspiring it with the mantras hurled it at the head of Prahasta.

sa: इन्द्रेण श्रूयते राजन् सभार्येण महात्मना। अनुभूतं महद् दुःखं देवराजेन भारत॥
en: We are told O king, O son of Bharata that the large minded Indra, the chief among the gods, had to endure great misery with his queen.

sa: तस्याः कौतूहलं त्वासीन्मन्त्रं प्रति नराधिप। आह्वानमकरोत् साथ तस्य देवस्य भाविनी॥
en: O lord of men, her curiosity was then excited to test the efficacy of the Mantras; and the maiden made up her mind to invoke that god.

sa: न च प्रज्ञायसे गच्छ पतस्वेति तमब्रवीत्। पतेयं सत्स्विति वचस्त्रिरुक्त्वा नहुषात्मजः॥
en: No one knows you here too, therefore down you and fall down.” “I shall fall among the good” the son of Nahusha said these words three times.

sa: वेदानेकेन सोऽधीते सुरामेकेन चापिबत्। एकेन च दिशः सर्वाः पिबन्निव निरीक्षते॥
en: With one mouth be read the Veda, with the second he drank wine and with the other he looked as if he would absorb the cardinal points.

sa: किमाभरणकृत्येन किं भोगै वितेन वा। मयि वा संगरहते प्रियपुत्रे विशेषतः॥
en: What is the use of ornaments? What of enjoyments and what even of life especially when you are deprived of the company of myself, your dear son.

sa: प्रहृष्टा दंशिता योधाः परानीकविदारणाः। तेषां मध्ये ययौ राजा कुन्तीपुत्रो युधिष्ठिरः॥
en: The cheerful soldiers, clad in coats of mail, were capable of piercing the hostile armies and in the midst of those went Yudhishthira the son of Kunti,

sa: महता शरवर्षेण राक्षसौ सोऽभ्यवर्षत। तौ चापि वीरौ संक्रुद्धावुभौ तं समवर्षताम्॥
en: And he (Lakshmana) covered the Rakshasas with a heavy downpour of arrows and those two (Rakshasa) heroes also in great wrath overwhelmed Lakshmana with showers (of arrows).

sa: श्रमेणोपार्जितं त्यक्तुं दुःखं शुद्धेन चेतसा। तत् सर्वं भवता साधो यथावदुपपादितम्॥
en: It is very hard to abandon in a pure spirit a thing earned by pain. O virtuous one, but all this has been duly achieved by you.

sa: अन्तर्हितः प्रकाशो वा दिव्यैर्दत्तवरैः शरैः। जहि शत्रूनमित्रघ्न मम शस्त्रभृतां वर॥
en: Remaining (either) invisible or visible, O slayer of foes, the best of those that wield weapon, kill my enemies by celestials weapons granted to you as boons.

sa: अथ शोणान् सदश्वांस्तान् हंसवर्णैमनोजवैः। मिश्रितान् समरे दृष्ट्वा व्यस्मयन्त रणे नराः॥
en: Beholding his excellent red horses mixing with those (of Arjuna) white as swans and fleet as the mind in the encounter, all people were filled with surprise.

sa: रावणिस्तु यदा नैनं विशेषयति सायकैः। ततो गुरुतरं यत्नमातिष्ठद् बलिनां वरः॥
en: When the son of Ravana, the strongest of the strong, could not get the better of his adversary by his arrows, he began to make vigorous exertions.

sa: उपस्थितस्य कामस्य प्रतिवादो न विद्यते। अपि निर्मुक्तदेहस्य कामरक्तस्य किं पुनः॥
en: Should a man's lineage be jaded about, O king and also by his food and dress. There is no struggling with a desire when it come on.

sa: मान्यमानयिता जन्म कुले महति विन्दति। व्यसनैर्न त संयोगं प्राप्नोति विजितेन्द्रियः॥
en: He who honours those to whom honour is due obtains birth in an illustrious family and he who has subdued his senses never mects with any misfortune.

sa: संस्मरन् परुषा वाचः सूतपुत्रस्य पाण्डवः। निःश्वासपरमो दीनो बिभ्रत् कोपविषं महत्॥
en: Remembering the harsh words of the Suta's son, the Pandava, repressing the venom of his wrath passed his days in humble guise and he often sighed heavily.

sa: वैशम्पायन उवाच इत्युक्त्वा तं महाबाहुर्भीमो भीमपराक्रमः। सहसोत्पत्य कौन्तेयः प्रहस्येदमुवाच ह॥
en: Vaishampayana said Having said this to him, and jumping up all on a sudden, the mighty-armed Bhima, the son of Kunti, endued with dreadful prowess, smilingly said.

sa: तदलं ते विरोधेन शमं गच्छ नृपात्मज) वासुदेवेन तीर्थेन कुलं रक्षितुमर्हसि॥
en: Fight would therefore be useless; effect peace, O son of a ruler of men, by means of Vasudeva; it is proper that you should save your family.

sa: कथं ते सूतपुत्रेण वध्यमानां प्रियां सतोम्। मर्षयन्ति यथा क्लीबा बलवन्तोऽमितौजसः॥
en: How do these inighty personages of exceeding energy quietly suffer, like eunuchs, their beloved and chaste wife to be thus outraged by the son of a Suta?

sa: यदि सापि दुरात्मानं शमयेद् दुष्टचेतसम्। अपि कृष्णस्य सुहृदस्तिष्ठेम वचने वयम्॥
en: If she can lead that wicked-souled one of vicious heart, to peace then shall we be able to act up to the words of Krishna, our wellwisher.

sa: पराजयश्च मरणान्मन्ये नैव विशिष्यते। यस्य स्याद् विजयः कृष्ण तस्याप्यपचयो ध्रुवम्॥
en: Defeat is not very much better than death I think; he on whose side victory is declared, O Krishna, also has surely to meet with a loss.

sa: यथाहं त्वदृते वीर नान्यं स्वप्नेऽप्यचिन्तयम्। तथा मे देवनिर्दिष्टस्त्वमेव हि पतिर्भव॥
en: As, O hero, I have thought of no other person than you even in my dreams, so you only be my husband as ordained by the gods."

sa: अहो पार्थ निमित्तानि विपरीतानि पश्यसि। स्वप्नान्ते जागारान्ते च तस्मात् प्रशममिच्छसि।॥
en: Alas, O son of Pritha, you see in your mind's eye the omens unfavourable to you, whether you are asleep or awake. Therefore do you desire peace!

sa: नमस्कृतः सर्वभूतैः सर्वभूता सान्त्वयत्। हत्वा शत्रु प्रहृष्टात्मा वासवः सह दैवतैः॥
en: Being bowed down to by all beings, he encouraged all the beings in his turn. Slaying the enemy, the mind of Vasava became delighted with the gods.

sa: वामे स्कन्धे तु वामोरूर्भर्तुर्बाहुं निवेश्य च। दक्षिणेन परिष्वज्य जगाम गजगामिनी॥
en: Then that lady of fair thighs, placing her husband's left hand on her left shoulder and embracing him by her right hand proceeded slowly like an elephant.

sa: सर्वे हि सर्वशो वीरास्तद्वचः प्रत्यपूजयन्। साधु सध्विति शैनेयं हर्षयन्तो युयुत्सवः॥
en: And all the heroes accepted and honoured these words of his in every way saying-Well done, well done; and the soldiers desirous of battle expressed their joy.

sa: वैशम्पायन उवाच स सुहृद्भिरमात्यैश्च भ्रातृभिः स्वजनेन च। बहुप्रकारमप्युक्तो निश्चयान्न विचाल्यते॥
en: Vaishampayana said : Though addressed in all manner of ways by his friends and counsellors and brothers and relatives, the king waved not from his firm resolve.

sa: कौरवाणां प्रवृत्तिं च गत्वा युद्धाधिकारिकाम्। निशम्य विनिवर्तिष्ये जयाय तव भारत॥
en: Having observed and made out the intentions of the sons of Kuru and their preparations for war I shall come back to make victory yours, O Bharata.

sa: पुरा मातुः पितुर्वापि यदि पश्यामि विप्रियम्। न जीविष्ये वरारोहे सत्येनात्मानमालभे॥
en: If I find my parents overtaken by any calamity, then, O fair girl, I swear by my own self I shall not bear life. I am see

sa: अत्र दुष्कृतकर्माणो नराः पच्यन्ति गालव। अत्र वैतरणी नाम नदी वितरणैर्वृता।।१४]i
en: Here men, the doers of wicked acts, cannot go, O Galava and here is the river Vaitarani surrounded by people who cannot obtain salvation and cross it.

sa: शकुनाश्चापसव्या नो वेदयन्ति महद् भयम्॥ गोमायुरेष सेनांयां रुदन् मध्येन धावति।
en: The vultures and kites are in the right path and presage a great danger. And the jackal too crying runs about in the midst of the army.

sa: अशिष्टा गतमर्यादा लोभेन हृतचेतसः। स्वेषु बन्धुषु मुख्येषु तद् वेत्थ पुरुषर्षभ॥
en: Those wicked ones, whose self-respect is gone and whose hearts have been perverted by avarice (are acting unfairly) towards their own chief friends, O best of men.

sa: ततस्तैरेव सहितो रामः सौमित्रिणा सह॥ यथागतेन मार्गेण प्रययौ स्वपुरं प्रति।
en: (He) then, together with all these and accompanied by the son of Sumitra, set out for his capital by the same route by which he had come.

sa: सेयं बुद्धिः परीता ते पुत्राणां भरतर्षभ। पाण्डवानां विरोधेन न चैनानवबुध्यसे॥
en: The dim intellect has overpowered your son, O bull of Bharata race; same now you do not clearly see it owing to your enmity against the Pandavas.

sa: पुत्रस्ते पृथिवीं जेता यशश्चास्य दिवं स्पृशेत्। हत्वा कुरूच संग्रामे वासुदेवसहायवान्॥
en: Your son will be the subjugator of the world and his fame will touch the heavens; having slain the Kurus in battle with the assistance of Vasudeva,

sa: तथा दृष्ट्वा यवीयांसं सहदेवं गवां पतिम्। गोषु गोवेषमायान्तं पाण्डुभूतास्मि भारत॥
en: 0 Bharata, beholding Sahadeva, the youngest of you all, in the capacity of a protector of kine and in the guise of a cowherd, I grow pale.

sa: दीर्घकालसमासक्तं विषमाशीविषो यथा। स मोक्ष्यति रणे तेजः पुत्रेषु मम संजय॥
en: Like venomous snake having accumulated its poison for a long time, he (Bhima) will fling his strength on my sons in the field of battle, O Sanjaya.

sa: क्रमेण चास्य ते पुत्रा व्यवर्धन्त महौजसः। वेदेषु सरहस्येषु धनुर्वेदेषु पारगाः॥
en: Those sons of his, gradually grew up in strength, obtained mastery over the Vedas together with all their mysteries and became skilled in the science of weapons.

sa: तेऽन्ववर्तन् पितृन् सर्वे यशसा च बलेन च। भेत्तारो गिरिशृङ्गाणां शालतालशिलायुधाः॥
en: They all took after their fathers, in strength and fame; they were capable of breaking down mountain summits and their weapons were trees of Shala and Tala.

sa: वैशम्पायन उवाच आपद्धर्मार्थकुशलो महाबुद्धियुधिष्ठिरः। सर्वान् भ्रातृन् समानीय वासुदेवं च शाश्वतम्॥
en: Vaishampayana said Yudhishthira, who was skillful in virtue and worldly profit especially in seasons of calamities, having summoned together all his brothers as also the eternal Vasudeva,

sa: योऽयं राज्ञो विराटस्य कीचको नाम सारथिः। त्यक्तधर्मा नृशंसश्च नरस्त्रीसम्मतः प्रियः॥
en: This very Kichaka is the principal ruler of the king Virata. He is devoid of virtue, cruel, favoured by the king and liked by women at large.

sa: संयुगं ये गमिष्यन्ति नररूपेण मृत्युना। नियतं चोदिता धात्रा सिंहेनेव महामृगाः॥
en: Those who encounter in battle that death in human shape have their dooms settled by the father of the universe, like those of large deer encountering lions,

sa: दूताश्चरन्ति पृथिवीं कृत्स्नां नृपतिशासनात्। भैमी किल स्म भर्तारं द्वितीयं वरयिष्यति॥
en: At the command of the monarch, the messengers are roving all over the world, proclaiming that the daughter of king Bhima would surely choose a second husband.

sa: पितॄन् देवानृषीन् विप्रान् पूजयित्वा महातपाः। सप्त मुख्यान् महामेधानाहरद् यमुनां प्रति॥
en: That one of fervid devotion, who having worshipped the Pitris, the Devas, the Rishi and the Brahmanas on the banks of the Yamuna, performed seven horse sacrifices,

sa: तामिस्रं प्रथमं पक्षं वीतशोकभयो वस। अलकाः सह गन्धर्वैर्यक्षाश्च सह किन्नरैः॥
en: Dwell there without fear or anxiety during the first dark fortnight. The Gandharvas together with the inhabitants of the Alaka and the Kinnaras together with the Yakshas,

sa: पुलिन्दांश्च रणे जित्वा ययौ दक्षिणतः पुरः। युयुधे पाण्ड्यराजेन दिवसं नकुलानुजः॥
en: Having defeated in battle the Pulindas, he marched towards the south. The younger brother of Nakula (Sahadeva) then fought for a day with the king of Pandya.

sa: न च मन्युस्त्वया कार्यो भीमसेनस्य पाण्डव। कालेनैते हताः पूर्वं निमित्तमनुजस्त्व।॥
en: Nor, O Pandava, you ought to be angry with Bhimasena. They (the Rakshasas and Yakshas) were killed before by Destiny, your younger brother being merely the instrument.

sa: तैस्तात बलिभिर्गुप्ता यातुधानैश्च रक्षिताः। दुर्गमाः पर्वताः पार्थ समाधि परमं कुरु॥
en: O child, O son of Pritha, protected by them and watched over by the Rakshashas, these mountains have become inaccessible. Therefore perform the great concentration of mind.

sa: सोऽस्मदर्थे व्रतं तात चर त्वं ब्रह्महिंसनम्। समर्थोऽप्यहमेकाकी कर्म कर्तुमिदं मुने॥
en: O brother, on my behalf, observe a vow prescribed in the case of killing a Brahmana. O Rishi, I shall alone be able to perform this act.

sa: मृदुर्भवत्यवज्ञातस्तीक्ष्णादुद्विजते जनः। काले प्राप्ते द्वयं चैतद् यो वेद स महीपतिः॥
en: The humble and forgiving person is always neglected; while those that are powerful assail others; he is the king who takes recourse to both in proper time.

sa: इह ते वै चरून् प्राश्नऋषयश्च विशाम्पते। यमुना चाक्षयस्रोता कृष्णश्छेह तपोरतः॥
en: O king, here did they cook charu (rice with milk) with the Rishis; here is also the Yamuna of everlasting current where Krishna engaged himself in asceticism.

sa: धर्म तु ब्राह्मणस्याहुः स्वाध्यायं दममार्जवम्॥ इन्द्रियाणां निग्रहं च शाश्वतं द्विजसत्तम।
en: The virtue of the Brahmana is said to consist in the study of the Vedas, in the repression of all passions and in the simplicity of manners.

sa: वेदी शूर्पारके तात जगदग्नेर्महात्मनः। रम्या पाषाणतीर्था च पुनश्चन्द्रा च भारत॥
en: O child, O descendant of Bharata, in the charming Tirtha called Shurparaka, are the two sacrificial platforms of the high-souled son of Jamadagni called Pashana and Punashchandra.

sa: ततः शैलोत्तमस्याचात् पाण्डवान् प्रति मारुतः। अवहत् सर्वमाल्यानि गन्धवन्ति शुभानि च॥
en: Vaishampayana said : Then from the top of that excellent mountain several kinds of auspicious and fragrant flowers were carried along by the wind towards the Pandavas.

sa: प्राणान्तिके विवाहे च वक्तव्यमनृतं भवेत्। अनृतेन भवेत् सत्यं सत्येनैवानृतं भवेत्॥
en: In life being at risk and in marriage, it is proper to speak an untruth. Sometimes by untruth, truth is maintained and by truth untruth is maintained.

sa: यथा पुण्यानि तीर्थानि पुण्यान्यायतनानि च। उपास्य पुण्यं लब्ध्वा च भवत्यमरलोकभाक्॥
en: As is the man who earns virtues by visiting the Tirthas and by drinking their sacred water and thus by earning virtue adored in the celestials region.

sa: सा तस्य शीलमाज्ञाय तस्माच्छापाच्च बिभ्यती। तेजस्वितां च रैभ्यस्य तथेत्युक्त्वाऽऽजगाम ह॥
en: Knowing his character and fearing his course and thinking (also) of the great power of Raibhya, she said, “Be it so" (then) and she went to him.

sa: न चाप्यतः परं शक्यं गन्तुं भरतसत्तमाः। विहारो ह्यत्र देवानाममानुषगतिस्तु सा॥
en: O most excellent of the Bharatas, it is impossible to proceed beyond this. That place being the sporting-ground of the celestials, men can have no access there.

sa: दुर्योधने च राजेन्द्रे स्थिते पुरुषसत्तमे। कृपे च भारताचार्ये कथं कृष्णस्त्वयार्चितः॥
en: When that best of men, that king of kings, Duryodhana, and also that preceptor of the Kuru race, Kripa, are present here, why Krishna has been worshipped?

sa: वैशम्पायन उवाच युधिष्ठिरस्तमासाद्य तपसा दग्धकिल्बिषम्। अभ्यवादयत प्रीतः शिरसा नाम कीर्तयन्॥
en: Having approached him (Arstisena) whose sins were consumed by austerities and having announced his name, Yudhishthira with great pleasure bowed down to him by bending his head.

sa: तौ मन्नियोगाद् ब्रह्मर्षे क्षितौ जातौ महाद्युती। भूमे रावतरणं महावीरों करिष्यतः॥
en: O Brahmarshi, those two effulgent ones have at my request taken their birth on earth. Those two greatly powerful ones will remove the burden of the earth.

sa: ततो राज्ञः प्रधानत्वं शास्त्रप्रामाण्यदर्शनात्। उत्तरः सिद्ध्यते पक्षो येन राजेति भाषितम्॥
en: Therefore by the authority of the Shastras the greatness of the king is established. And I declare for him who has spoken in favour of the king.

sa: यदिदं वैश्वदेवं ते शान्तये क्रियते गृहे। तद् दत्त्वातिथिभूतेभ्यो राजञ्छिष्टेन जीवसि॥
en: Having distributed duly, O king, all to the guests in the Vishvadeva sacrifice that is solemnized in your house for your peace you live upon what remains.

sa: आर्षं प्रमाणमुत्क्रम्यधर्मं न प्रतिपालयन्। सर्वशास्त्रातिगो मूढः शं जन्मसु न विन्दति॥
en: That stupid person, who transgresses the evidences of the Rishis, who does not follow religion and who transgresses all the scriptures, never obtains bliss in any life.

sa: इति ब्रुवन् पाण्डवेयान् पर्युपास्ते स्म नित्यदा। परीप्समानः पार्थानां कलापानिधनूंषि च॥ अन्तर सम्परिप्रेप्सुयॊपद्या हरणं प्रति। दुष्टात्मा पापबुद्धिः स नाम्ना ख्यातो जटासुरः॥
en: Alleging that he was a Brahmana wellskilled in counsel and learned in all the Shastras, he always lived with the Pandavas with the intention of possessing their bows, quivers and other weapons. He had been watching an opportunity to steal away Draupadi. That wicked and sinful wretch was known by the name of Jatasura.

sa: अहं हि ब्राह्मणः पूर्वमासं द्विजवरात्मजः। वेदाध्यायी सुकुशलो वेदाङ्गानां च पारगः॥
en: O son of the best of Brahmanas, I was a Brahmana previously (in my another birth); I was well-read in the Vedas and earned in the Vedangas.

sa: तस्य श्रान्तस्य शुष्केण कण्ठेन क्रोशतस्तदा। नाश्रौषीत् कश्चन तदा शकुनेरिव वाशतः॥
en: With fatigue and with a perched throat, he cried in a feeble voice which resembled like the inarticulate notes of a bird. Therefore none heard his voice.

sa: वैशम्पायन उवाच ततस्तान् परिविश्वस्तान् वसतस्तत्र पाण्डवान्। पर्वतेन्द्रे द्विजैः सार्धं पार्थागमनकाझ्या॥
en: Vaishampayana said : When the Pandavas had grown confident of living on that king of mountains, with the Brahmanas in expectation of the return of Partha (Arjuna).

sa: श्रोतुमिच्छामहे विप्र यदि श्रोतव्यमित्युत। स तानुवाच नास्माकं मृत्युः प्रभवते नृपाः॥
en: O Brahmana, we are (very) curious to hear it, if indeed it can be heard.” (Thereupon) he replied “O kings, death cannot display its power before us.

sa: लोमश उवाच समुद्रं स समासाद्य वारुणिर्भगवानृषिः। उवाच सहितान् देवानृषींश्चैव समागतान्॥
en: Lomasha said: Coming to the ocean, the exalted Rishi, the son of Varuna thus spoke to the assembled celestials and the Rishis, who had come with him.

sa: असम्भवे त्वस्य हेतुः प्रायश्चित्तं तु लक्षयेत्। कृते कर्मणि राजेन्द्र तथानृण्यमवाप्नुते॥
en: If success becomes impossible a person should remove the difficulties; when engaged in action, O king, he is freed from debts (whether he is successful or not).

sa: वृहदश्व उवाच एवमुक्तः स देवैस्तैर्नैषधः पुनरब्रवीत्। सुरक्षितानि वेश्मानि प्रवेष्टुं कथमुत्सहे॥
en: Brihadashva said : The king of the Nishadhas, being thus spoken by the gods, said again to them: "How can I dare enter those palaces so well-guarded."

sa: इला सरस्वती सिन्धुर्यमुना नर्मदा तथा। नानातीर्थेषु रम्येषु सूपस्पृष्टं सह द्विजैः॥
en: We have with the Brahmanas bathed in the Ila, in the Sarasvati, in the Sindhu, in the Yamuna, in the Narmada and in various other charming Tirthas.

sa: अलक्ष्म्या किल संयुक्तो वृत्रं हत्वा शचीपतिः। आप्लुतः सर्वपापेभ्यः समझायां व्यमुच्यत॥
en: When the lord of Sachi, (Indra) became devoid of his prosperity in consequence of killing Vritra, he was cleansed of his sins by bathing in the Samanga.

sa: स दृष्ट्वा फाल्गुनं वीरं चिरस्य प्रियमागतम्। पर्यष्वजत दाशार्हः पुनः पुनररिंदमः॥
en: And that tormentor of foes, the descendant of the Dasharhas, having met with his beloved and heroic Arjuna after a long time, embraced him again and again.

sa: वैशम्पायन उवाच काम्यकं प्राप्य कौरव्य युधिष्ठिरपुरोगमाः। कृतातिथ्या मुनिगणैनिषेदुः सह कृष्णया॥
en: Vaishampayana said : Arriving at (the forest of) Kamyaka and being hospitably received by the saints, Yudhishthira and the other Pandavas began to dwell there with Krishna.

sa: ततो युद्धं समभवद् देवानां दानवैः सह। मुहूर्तं भरतश्रेष्ठ लोकत्रासकरं महत्॥
en: O best of the Bharata race, then a great battle appalling on the three worlds was fought by the celestials with the Danavas for a short while.

sa: वैशम्पायन उवाच निदाघान्तकरः कालः सर्वभूतसुखावहः। तत्रैव वसतां तेषां प्रावृट् समभिपद्यत॥
en: Vaishampayana said: While they (the Pandavas) were living there, the rainy season, which puts an end to summer and is agreeable to all creatures, made its appearance.

sa: अग्निर्यदा त्वेक एव बहुत्वं चास्य कर्मसु। दृश्यते भगवन् सर्वमेतदिच्छामि वेदितुम्॥
en: O exalted one, there is but one fire, but it is seen, according to the nature of its actions as many. I desire to hear all this.

sa: क्षीणायुषो महाराज तरुणो वृद्धशीलिनः। तरुणानां च यच्छील तद् वृद्धेषु प्रजायते॥
en: O great king, when men become so shortlived, mere youths act like old men, while all that is seen in the youths is seen in old men.

sa: यथेदं व्रतमारब्धं नलस्याराधने मया। तेन सत्येन मे देवास्तमेव प्रदिशन्तु मे॥
en: When I have commenced my vow for the worship of king Nala; for the sake of that truth, it behoves the celestials to reveal him to me.

sa: ब्राह्मणेभ्यो ददद् ग्रामान् गाश्च राजन् सहस्रशः। मुच्यते सर्वपापेभ्यस्तमोभ्य इव चन्द्रमाः॥
en: O king, as the moon emerges from the clouds, so does a king emerge from all sins by bestowing thousands of villages and kine on the Brahmanas.

sa: मया तु निहते तस्मिन् रावणे लोककण्टके। कीर्तिनश्येद् राघवस्य तत एतदुपेक्षितम्॥
en: But if I had killed Ravana, that thorn of the worlds, the glory of Raghu's son (Rama) would have been obscured, for this I left him alone.

sa: ततोऽहं सहसा राजन् वायुवेगेन निःसृतः। महात्मनो मुखात् तस्य विवृतात् पुरुषोत्तम॥
en: O king, O foremost of men, then I suddenly came out of the open mouth of that high-souled one by means of a great gust of wind.

sa: तत्रापि चाप्लुत्य महानुभावः संतर्पयामास पितृन् सुरांचा द्विजातिमुख्येषुधनं विसृज्य गोदावरी सागरगामगच्छत्॥
en: That magnanimous king, bathing there, offered oblations to the Pitris and the celestials. Giving wealth to the foremost of Brahmanas, he then went to the ocean-going Godavari.

sa: अहो रूपमहो कान्तिरहोधैर्य महात्मनः। कोऽयं देवोऽथवा यक्षो गन्धर्वो वा भविष्यति॥
en: Oh! what beauty, what effulgence and what patience are possessed by this high-souled one! Who is he! Is he a god or a Yaksha or a Gandharva?

sa: शुक्लकृष्णगतिर्देवो यो बिभर्ति हुताशनम्। अकल्मषः कल्मषाणां कर्ता क्रोधाश्रितस्तु सः॥ कपिलं परमर्षि च यं प्राहुर्यतयः सदा। अग्निः स कपिलो नाम सांख्ययोगप्रवर्तकः॥
en: The divine spirit whose course is marked by black and white stains, who is the supporter of the fire, who though free from sin is the accomplisher of tainted Karma, whom the wise man consider to be a great Rishi, is the fire named Kapila, the propounder of that system of (Yoga) called Sankhya.

sa: ततस्ता मातरः सर्वाः प्राक्रोशन् भृशदुःखिताः। प्रवार्य जन्तुं सहसा स शब्दस्तुमुलोऽभवत्॥
en: The mothers were greatly distressed to find the child stung by the ant; and they stood round him and began to cry as loudly as the boy.

sa: कपिलावटं ततो गच्छेत् तीर्थसेवी नराधिप। उपोष्य रजनीं तत्र गोसहस्रफलं लभेत्॥
en: O ruler of men, then the pilgrim should go to Kapilavata; and fasting there for one night, one obtains the fruits of giving away one thousand kine.

sa: भीमसेनस्तु विख्यातो महान्तं दंष्ट्रिणं बलात्। निघ्नन् नागशतप्राणो वने तस्मिन् महाबलः॥
en: In that forest, the renowned Bhimasena of great prowess and endued with the strength of a hundred elephants, killed (man) dreadful wild boars simply by brute force.

sa: अयं च पार्थो बीभत्सुर्वरिष्ठो ज्याविकर्षणे। आस्ते परमसंतप्तो नूनं सिंह इवाशये॥
en: This son of Pritha, Vivatsu (Arjuna) is foremost in drawing the bow-string. He is certainly much aggrieved, though he lives (quietly) like a lion in its den.
